abstract: Generalized symmetries and topological excitations, as well as symmetry anomalies and the statistics of topological excitations, are widely believed to be related. There are, however, pitfalls in how this relation is established. A lattice truncation of a symmetry transformation to a finite patch gives a symmetry patch operator that creates symmetry defects at its boundary. This geometric picture resembles a hopping operator creating topological excitations at the boundary of its support, but does not provide well-defined statistics, let alone guarantee agreement with the symmetry anomaly. A more natural and robust relation is that the hopping operators of topological excitations are symmetric: they commute with symmetry transformations. Under suitable assumptions, this condition yields a one-to-one correspondence between statistics and anomalies. We further couple boundary matter to a DW gauge field in one higher dimension to explain this relation from the perspective of gauging. A hopping operator is, in essence, a gauge-invariant operator acting on the physical degrees of freedom after gauging. Once the gauge-field background is fixed, global symmetry comes from gauge transformations that preserve that background, while the symmetric condition on hopping is precisely the remaining gauge invariance. This distinction clarifies potential misconceptions in the literature and provides a more reliable framework for comparing symmetries and topological excitations.
summary:
人们普遍认为广义对称性和拓扑激发，以及对称异常和拓扑激发的统计量是相关的。然而，这种关系的建立方式存在缺陷。对称变换到有限面片的晶格截断给出了在其边界处创建对称缺陷的对称面片算子。该几何图类似于在其支撑边界处创建拓扑激励的跳跃算子，但没有提供明确定义的统计数据，更不用说保证与对称异常的一致性。更自然和稳健的关系是拓扑激励的跳跃算子是对称的：它们通过对称变换进行交换。在适当的假设下，这种情况会产生统计数据和异常之间的一一对应关系。我们进一步将边界物质耦合到一个更高维度的 DW 规范场，以从测量的角度解释这种关系。跳跃算子本质上是在测量后作用于物理自由度的规范不变算子。

一旦规范场背景固定，全局对称性就来自于保留该背景的规范变换，而跳跃的对称条件恰恰是剩余的规范不变性。这种区别澄清了文献中潜在的误解，并为比较对称性和拓扑激励提供了更可靠的框架。

title: Topological entanglement entropy in 3D gravity
abstract: We derive an entropy formula for a recently proposed tensor network model of states in 3D gravity which satisfy the constraint equations of diffeomorphism invariance, and including the effects of matter. After accounting for the invertibility of the spacetime metric, we argue that this formula matches the quantum extremal surface formula (for small but finite $G_N$), and is not restricted to time symmetric spacetimes. We derive the result via canonical quantization without relying on path integrals, and discuss an extension to compact bulk subregions.
summary: 我们推导了最近提出的 3D 引力状态张量网络模型的熵公式，该模型满足微分同胚不变性的约束方程，并包括物质的影响。在考虑了时空度量的可逆性后，我们认为该公式与量子极值面公式（对于小但有限的$G_N$）相匹配，并且不限于时间对称时空。我们通过规范量化而不依赖路径积分得出结果，并讨论了紧凑块体子区域的扩展。

title: Cosmological Correlators from Scattering Amplitudes: A Review
abstract: The primordial statistics underlying the CMB and large-scale structure are encoded in late-time cosmological correlation functions (constructed from the coefficients of the wavefunction of the universe). They are the closest analogue cosmology has to an $S$-matrix, yet the standard $S$-matrix toolkit does not directly apply. This review explains how the modern scattering-amplitudes program (spinor helicity, on-shell recursion, the double copy, positive geometry, and generalized unitarity) has nevertheless been extended to cosmology and, through a single analytic continuation, to Euclidean anti-de Sitter space, where the same objects appear as holographic boundary correlators and are often cleanest to compute. The organizing framework is momentum space on the late-time boundary, where the primordial statistics are simplest and where the total energy of the external legs, the sum of their momentum magnitudes, controls the analytic structure. At the total-energy singularity, the flat-space scattering amplitude emerges. We develop this toolkit starting from the wave equation and use it to compute tree-level scalar, gauge-field, and graviton correlators, exposing relations across spins and dimensions. We then show how bulk integrals can be bypassed using cosmological polytopes, on-shell recursion, and curved-space versions of the double copy, before extending the discussion to loops, soft limits, transition amplitudes, and (A)dS cutting rules. Finally, we connect these structures to inflationary observables and to three allied programs: the cosmological optical theorem, the cosmological bootstrap, and the cosmological collider. We conclude with a map of the current frontier and a set of open and interesting problems.
summary:
CMB 和大尺度结构背后的原始统计数据被编码在晚期宇宙学相关函数中（由宇宙波函数的系数构成）。它们是最接近 $S$ 矩阵的模拟宇宙学，但标准 $S$ 矩阵工具包并不直接适用。这篇综述解释了现代散射振幅程序（旋量螺旋、壳上递归、双拷贝、正几何和广义酉性）如何扩展到宇宙学，并通过单个分析延拓扩展到欧几里得反德西特空间，其中相同的物体表现为全息边界相关器，并且通常是最干净的计算。组织框架是后期边界上的动量空间，其中原始统计最简单，并且外部腿的总能量（它们的动量大小之和）控制分析结构。在总能量奇点处，出现平坦空间散射振幅。

我们从波动方程开始开发这个工具包，并用它来计算树级标量、规范场和引力子相关器，揭示跨自旋和维度的关系。然后，我们将展示如何使用宇宙多面体、壳内递归和双副本的弯曲空间版本来绕过体积分，然后将讨论扩展到循环、软极限、跃迁振幅和 (A)dS 切割规则。最后，我们将这些结构与暴胀可观测量和三个相关程序联系起来：宇宙学光学定理、宇宙学引导程序和宇宙学对撞机。最后，我们给出了当前前沿的地图和一系列开放且有趣的问题。

title: Deterministic Hypergraph SYK: Melonic Dominance and Maximal Chaos Without Disorder Averaging
abstract: We show that SYK-like melonic solvability and maximal chaos survive in a sparse deterministic model, without disorder averaging. Our deterministic hypergraph SYK model (hSYK) consists of $N$ Majorana fermions on a $q$-uniform, $d$-regular interaction hypergraph with only $O(dN)$ interaction terms and uniform positive couplings. Under explicit geometric and spectral expansion conditions, its two-point function satisfies the standard melonic Schwinger-Dyson equation up to $O(d^{-1})$ corrections, while the leading bilocal effective action coincides with that of ordinary SYK at the dominant large-$d$ saddle. Its connected four-point function factorizes into a temporal SYK ladder kernel and a line-graph random walk. A finite line-graph spectral gap controls the visibility of the maximally chaotic uniform mode in generic localized OTOCs and, by gapping non-uniform spatial modes in the bilocal spectrum, excludes additional light fluctuation modes beyond the Schwarzian. Exact diagonalization further shows melonic two-point scaling, single-instance Wigner-Dyson statistics, and the predicted graph-controlled spatial decay of OTOCs. The model therefore offers a disorder-free realization of the essential melonic and chaotic features of SYK, in a form more amenable to quantum simulation.
summary:
我们证明了类似 SYK 的甜瓜可解性和最大混沌在稀疏确定性模型中存在，无需无序平均。我们的确定性超图 SYK 模型 (hSYK) 由 $N$ 马约拉纳费米子组成，位于 $q$-均匀、$d$-正则交互超图上，仅具有 $O(dN)$ 交互项和均匀正耦合。在显式几何和谱展开条件下，其两点函数满足标准甜瓜施温格-戴森方程高达 $O(d^{-1})$ 校正，而主要的双局部有效作用与普通 SYK 在主要大 $d$ 鞍处的作用一致。其连接的四点函数分解为时间 SYK 梯形内核和线图随机游走。有限线图光谱间隙控制通用局域 OTOC 中最大混沌均匀模式的可见性，并通过间隙双局域光谱中的非均匀空间模式，排除 Schwarzian 之外的其他光波动模式。精确对角化进一步显示了甜瓜两点缩放、单实例 Wigner-Dyson 统计数据以及 OTOC 的预测图控制空间衰减。

因此，该模型以更适合量子模拟的形式提供了 SYK 基本甜瓜和混沌特征的无序实现。

title: Schwarzschild Black Hole in Uniform Magnetic Field in Einstein-Maxwell-Dilaton Theories
abstract: We obtain the Kerr black hole in an external uniform magnetic field in the Kaluza-Klein (KK) theory via a standard solution-generating technique. Using this as our starting point, we construct exact static solutions describing a Schwarzschild black hole immersed in the external uniform magnetic field in general string-inspired Einstein-Maxwell-dilaton (EMD) theories, thereby embedding the static Kerr-Bertotti-Robinson (KBR) solution into the general framework of EMD theories. We also construct electrovacuum solutions involving both electric and magnetic fields in EMD theories and generalize the system to include mutltiple Maxwell fields and dilatons. These equations of motion can be reduced to Toda-like equations, allowing us to obtain analytic electrovacua associated with Toda equations of all rank-2 Lie groups. We further construct exact solutions of a Schwarzschild black hole immersed in these electrovacua.
summary: 我们通过标准解生成技术在 Kaluza-Klein (KK) 理论中获得了外部均匀磁场中的克尔黑洞。以此为出发点，我们在一般弦启发的爱因斯坦-麦克斯韦膨胀（EMD）理论中构造了描述浸没在外部均匀磁场中的史瓦西黑洞的精确静态解，从而将静态克尔-贝托蒂-罗宾逊（KBR）解嵌入到EMD理论的一般框架中。我们还在 EMD 理论中构建了涉及电场和磁场的电真空解决方案，并将该系统推广到包括多个麦克斯韦场和膨胀子。这些运动方程可以简化为类 Toda 方程，使我们能够获得与所有 2 阶李群的 Toda 方程相关的解析电真空。我们进一步构建了浸入这些电真空中的史瓦西黑洞的精确解。

title: Tameness and Complexity in Quantum Field Theory and Gravity
abstract: Finiteness appears to play a fundamental role in the mathematical structures underlying the laws of physics. Tame geometry, defined by the theory of o-minimality, provides a framework for making this idea precise. In this thesis we study the concept of tameness and finiteness of complexity across applications in quantum field theory and quantum gravity, and demonstrate that many classes of physical functions and theories are tame. To quantify these ideas, we use the novel theory of sharp o-minimality to measure the complexity of physical objects. The analysis covers wavefunctions in quantum mechanics, classical field configurations, non-perturbative observables in zero-dimensional quantum field theories, cosmological correlation functions, and Lagrangians of effective field theories. Finally, we argue that the emergence of tameness in physics aligns with manifestations of finiteness in quantum gravity, converging towards the idea that effective theories of quantum gravity admit a description of finite complexity. The thesis contains an introductory review for readers who wish to get familiar with tame geometry and its applications to physics.
summary: 有限性似乎在物理定律背后的数学结构中发挥着重要作用。由 o 极小理论定义的驯服几何学为使这一想法变得精确提供了一个框架。在本文中，我们研究了量子场论和量子引力中应用的驯服性和复杂性有限性的概念，并证明许多类别的物理函数和理论是驯服的。为了量化这些想法，我们使用新颖的锐 o 极小理论来衡量物理对象的复杂性。分析涵盖量子力学中的波函数、经典场配置、零维量子场论中的非微扰可观测量、宇宙学相关函数和有效场论中的拉格朗日量。最后，我们认为物理学中驯服性的出现与量子引力中有限性的表现相一致，趋向于这样的观点：有效的量子引力理论承认有限复杂性的描述。本文为希望熟悉几何几何及其在物理学中的应用的读者提供了介绍性评论。

title: Strong coupling spectrum of $\mathrm{AdS}_3\times \mathrm{S}^3$ from string field theory
abstract: We consider type IIB string theory on $\mathrm{AdS}_3\times \mathrm{S}^3\times \mathbb{T}^4$ in a large AdS radius expansion at arbitrary values of the relative RR and NS-NS fluxes. We develop a method for computing scaling dimensions in the dual CFT in this limit by combining a string field theory calculation, valid at finite quantized NS-NS flux but perturbative in RR flux, with a finite mixed-flux ansatz, which is constrained by worldsheet parity and motivated by classical string solutions. We apply the method to three families of states. In the pure-RR limit, our results agree both with a family of states computed using the worldsheet bootstrap and with another family computed using integrability.
summary: 我们考虑 $\mathrm{AdS}_3\times \mathrm{S}^3\times \mathbb{T}^4$ 上的 IIB 型弦理论，在相对 RR 和 NS-NS 通量的任意值的大 AdS 半径展开中。我们开发了一种在此极限下计算对偶 CFT 中缩放维数的方法，通过将弦场论计算与有限混合通量 ansatz 相结合，弦场论计算在有限量化 NS-NS 通量下有效，但在 RR 通量中存在微扰，有限混合通量 ansatz 受到世界表奇偶校验的约束并受到经典弦解的启发。我们将该方法应用于三个国家家族。在纯 RR 极限中，我们的结果与使用世界表引导程序计算的状态族和使用可积性计算的另一个状态族一致。

title: Algebraic Complexity and Black Hole Complementarity
abstract: We develop an operator algebraic generalization of the Yoshida-Kitaev information recovery protocol that applies to von Neumann algebras of arbitrary type. The construction is based on finite-index inclusions, with the Jones basic construction and canonical endomorphisms providing the central algebraic tools. Unlike the finite-dimensional qubit description, the infinite-dimensional theory exhibits new structural phenomena that play an essential role in information recovery. In particular, the diary information is represented non-locally by a choice of Pimsner-Popa basis associated with the inclusion. Exploiting the Temperley-Lieb relations satisfied by the Jones projections, we introduce an algebraic notion of computational complexity and show that it is naturally measured by the Jones-Kosaki index. For irreducible depth-two inclusions, we demonstrate that the information transfer is implemented by an algebraic Fourier transform. Finally, we discuss a potential spacetime interpretation of the construction, including the emergence of an island algebra in terms of (non-)isometric embeddings and an operator algebraic realization of black hole complementarity.
summary: 我们开发了适用于任意类型的冯·诺依曼代数的 Yoshida-Kitaev 信息恢复协议的算子代数推广。该构造基于有限索引包含，琼斯基本构造和规范自同态提供了中心代数工具。与有限维量子位描述不同，无限维理论展现了新的结构现象，在信息恢复中发挥着重要作用。特别地，日记信息通过与包含相关联的Pimsner-Popa基础的选择来非局部地表示。利用琼斯投影满足的 Temperley-Lieb 关系，我们引入了计算复杂性的代数概念，并表明它可以自然地通过 Jones-Kosaki 指数来衡量。对于不可约深度二包含体，我们证明信息传输是通过代数傅里叶变换实现的。最后，我们讨论了该构造的潜在时空解释，包括（非）等距嵌入方面岛代数的出现和黑洞互补性的算子代数实现。

title: Sphere path integrals for fermionic gauge fields
abstract: We consider spin-$s \geq \frac{3}{2}$ complex, strictly massless fermionic gauge fields on the four-sphere, $S^4$, which is the Euclidean continuation of de Sitter spacetime, dS$_4$. For $s=\frac{5}{2}$, after briefly discussing different options for the quantisation of the theory on dS$_4$, we compute the one-loop sphere path integral. We explain how it can be expressed in terms of functional determinants, generalising previous results for $s=\frac{3}{2}$. We proceed to rewrite the result in terms of `bulk' unitary Harish-Chandra characters in the discrete series of the de Sitter isometry group, $Spin(4,1)$, and `edge' characters. We then generalise the character expression of the sphere path integral for any complex, strictly massless spin-$s\geq\frac{3}{2}$ fermionic gauge potential. Additionally, we compute the coefficient of the logarithmic divergence of the $S^4$ path integral for all spin-$s \geq \frac{3}{2}$, and we show that it is fully encoded by bulk and edge characters. We further show that at one loop no imaginary phase appears for strictly massless fermionic gauge potentials, contrary to the case of bosons. Lastly, we confirm the exact one-loop cancellation between bulk and edge contributions for the case of an infinite tower of complex massless fermions of spins $s=\frac{1}{2}, \frac{3}{2},\dots$, observed recently.
summary:
我们考虑四球体 $S^4$ 上的自旋 $s \geq \frac{3}{2}$ 复杂的、严格无质量的费米子规范场，它是德西特时空 dS$_4$ 的欧几里得延续。对于 $s=\frac{5}{2}$，在简要讨论 dS$_4$ 理论量化的不同选项之后，我们计算单环球体路径积分。我们解释了如何用函数行列式来表达它，概括了 $s=\frac{3}{2}$ 的先前结果。我们继续根据 de Sitter 等距群的离散系列中的“批量”酉 Harish-Chandra 字符、$Spin(4,1)$ 和“边缘”字符重写结果。然后，我们将球体路径积分的特征表达式推广到任何复杂的、严格无质量的自旋 $s\geq\frac{3}{2}$ 费米子规范势。此外，我们计算了所有自旋 $s \geq \frac{3}{2}$ 的 $S^4$ 路径积分的对数散度系数，并且我们表明它完全由块体和边缘字符编码。我们进一步表明，与玻色子的情况相反，在一个循环中，对于严格无质量的费米子规范势，不会出现虚相。

最后，我们确认了最近观察到的自旋复杂无质量费米子无限塔 $s=\frac{1}{2}, \frac{3}{2},\dots$ 的情况下体积和边缘贡献之间的精确单环抵消。

title: Electroweak balls: non-topological solitons in the Weinberg-Salam theory
abstract: We construct a new class of smooth, finite-energy solitons in the bosonic $SU(2)\times U(1)$ Weinberg-Salam theory, which we dub $electroweak$ $balls$. Their localization mechanism is analogous in spirit to that of $Q$-balls: the charged vector fields possess a harmonic time dependence while the energy-momentum tensor remains time independent. We explicitly construct both spherically symmetric electric-type solutions and axisymmetric magnetic-type solutions, and show that they form families characterized by a finite frequency interval, a mass gap, and a two-branch structure. These configurations provide electroweak counterparts of Proca-Higgs balls, with the vector-boson masses generated by the Higgs mechanism rather than introduced explicitly. The construction is not tied to the measured parameters of the Standard Model. More generally, it applies to bosonic electroweak-type sectors with different gauge couplings, Higgs self-coupling and symmetry-breaking scale, and hence potentially very different characteristic particle and soliton mass scales. For the families studied here, we do not find solutions at the measured Standard Model couplings and mass ratios.
summary: 我们在玻色子 $SU(2)\times U(1)$ Weinberg-Salam 理论中构造了一类新的光滑、有限能量孤子，我们将其称为 $electricweak$ $balls$。它们的定位机制在本质上类似于 $Q$ 球：带电矢量场具有谐波时间依赖性，而能量动量张量保持时间无关。我们明确地构造了球对称电型解和轴对称磁型解，并表明它们形成了以有限频率间隔、质量间隙和双分支结构为特征的族。这些配置提供了普罗卡-希格斯球的电弱对应物，其矢量玻色子质量由希格斯机制生成，而不是明确引入。该结构与标准模型的测量参数无关。更一般地，它适用于具有不同规范耦合、希格斯自耦合和对称破缺尺度的玻色子电弱型扇区，因此可能具有非常不同的特征粒子和孤子质量尺度。对于此处研究的族，我们没有找到测量的标准模型耦合和质量比的解。

title: Fortuity on the conifold
abstract: To study the BPS black hole states in typical $\mathcal{N}=1$ AdS$_5$/CFT$_4$ models, we formulate a classical cohomology problem in the Klebanov-Witten theory, which is defined at a strongly coupled RG fixed point. We set up its weakly coupled cohomology problem in the UV theory, suggesting a refined notion of monotonous and fortuitous cohomologies so that simple baryonic operators belong to the former. We construct infinitely many fortuitous cohomologies in the $SU(2)\times SU(2)$ theory and interpret some of them as $N=2$ versions of hairy black hole states dressed by baryonic condensates. We also comment that the recently constructed fortuitous cohomologies in ABJM exhibit generalized monotonicity.
summary: 为了研究典型 $\mathcal{N}=1$ AdS$_5$/CFT$_4$ 模型中的 BPS 黑洞态，我们在 Klebanov-Witten 理论中提出了一个经典的上同调问题，该问题定义在强耦合 RG 不动点上。我们在UV理论中建立了它的弱耦合上同调问题，提出了单调和偶然上同调的改进概念，使得简单的重子算子属于前者。我们在 $SU(2)\times SU(2)$ 理论中构造了无限多个偶然上同调，并将其中一些解释为重子凝聚态毛状黑洞态的 $N=2$ 版本。我们还评论说，最近在 ABJM 中构建的偶然上同调表现出广义单调性。

title: Current Reconstruction and Higher Interactions in Gauge Theory
abstract: We revisit Deser's current reconstruction in first-order Yang--Mills theory with an independent two-form. We fix the quadratic auxiliary sector and the first gauge correction, and ask whether a prescribed curvature interaction can be added without higher-order action terms. For a compact semisimple gauge algebra, requiring the mixed Noether identity to close without a $gh$ action term fixes the algebraic auxiliary representative to the tangent representative, up to linear curvature and dual-curvature terms on each simple ideal. For the analytic radial class $U=\Phi(f\cdot f)$, with first nonlinear term $c_p(f\cdot f)^p$, no allowed representative avoids a third-order action correction when all second-order action coefficients vanish. A free-field scaling argument inside a root $\mathfrak{su}(2)$ subalgebra establishes this result for every compact semisimple gauge algebra. Ordinary covariantization and an auxiliary-field shift give an explicit completion. For $p=2$, its seven-gluon contact term cancels a nonzero tree-level Ward contraction at real nonsingular kinematics. We also study an affine star-gauge sector motivated by Seiberg--Witten maps, where strict current feedback and second-order action truncation select different representatives. Together these results show how the prescribed auxiliary data determine which interactions are required by current reconstruction.
summary:
我们用独立的二元形式重新审视Deser目前对一阶Yang-Mills理论的重构。我们修复了二次辅助扇区和第一规范修正，并询问是否可以在没有高阶作用项的情况下添加规定的曲率相互作用。对于紧凑半单规范代数，要求混合诺特恒等式在没有 $gh$ 作用项的情况下闭合，将代数辅助代表固定为切线代表，直到每个简单理想上的线性曲率和双曲率项。对于解析径向类 $U=\Phi(f\cdot f)$，具有第一个非线性项 $c_p(f\cdot f)^p$，当所有二阶作用系数消失时，没有允许的代表避免三阶作用校正。根 $\mathfrak{su}(2)$ 子代数内的自由场缩放参数为每个紧半单规范代数建立了这个结果。普通的协变化和辅助场移位给出了明确的完成。对于 $p=2$，其七胶子接触项取消了实非奇异运动学下的非零树级 Ward 收缩。

我们还研究了由 Seiberg-Witten 映射驱动的仿射星规扇区，其中严格的电流反馈和二阶动作截断选择不同的代表。这些结果共同显示了规定的辅助数据如何确定当前重建需要哪些交互。

title: Notes on de Sitter space
abstract: We discuss classical and quantum features of spacetimes with a positive cosmological constant. After introducing basic aspects of de Sitter cosmology and the classical geometry of de Sitter space, we consider de Sitter space both as a rigid background, on which quantum fields propagate, and as a fluctuating spacetime in its own right. We review the wavefunction of an expanding universe, black holes in de Sitter space, and the de Sitter entropy, and compare the cosmological horizon with the black hole horizon. The final three sections are dedicated to concrete models of de Sitter space in two, three and four spacetime dimensions.
summary: 我们讨论具有正宇宙学常数的时空的经典和量子特征。在介绍了德西特宇宙学的基本方面和德西特空间的经典几何之后，我们将德西特空间视为量子场在其上传播的刚性背景，以及其本身的波动时空。我们回顾了膨胀宇宙的波函数、德西特空间中的黑洞和德西特熵，并将宇宙视界与黑洞视界进行了比较。最后三个部分专门介绍德西特空间在两个、三个和四个时空维度上的具体模型。

title: Variational Solution of Non-Hermitian Quantum Field Theory in Two Dimensions
abstract: This work describes a variational technique to solve non-Hermitian quantum systems, in particular those with negative coupling quartic self-interaction. Differences of applying variational methods from standard quantum mechanics to non-Hermitian quantum mechanics -- including potential pitfalls -- are highlighted. A successful implementation of the variational approach for the non-Hermitian case is presented. The technique is used to analyze scalar quantum field theory in d=2 with negative quartic self-interaction in the Hamiltonian formulation in lattice discretization.
summary: 这项工作描述了一种解决非厄米量子系统的变分技术，特别是那些具有负耦合四次自相互作用的系统。强调了从标准量子力学到非厄米量子力学应用变分方法的差异（包括潜在的陷阱）。介绍了非厄米特情况下变分法的成功实现。该技术用于分析 d=2 中的标量量子场论，在晶格离散化的哈密顿公式中具有负四次自相互作用。

title: Conformal blocks and braiding matrices for RCFTs I: Virasoro minimal models
abstract: We develop a systematic method for computing the braiding matrices of four-point functions in RCFTs. This is implemented for the case of Virasoro minimal models. The first few terms of the conformal block series are directly computed through the Shapovalov form. The Fuchsian (BPZ) ODEs for order three and higher have accessory parameters that are fixed by this direct computation. We thus bypass the derivation from the null-state condition which gets tedious for higher-level null states. The braiding F-matrices are connection matrices between the Frobenius solutions at two singular points of the ODE. The F-matrices are computed numerically at first, agreeing with the results of Dotsenko--Fateev, which uses the Coulomb-gas formalism. We find that after a change of basis, the F-matrix is rendered unitary, which determines (products of) the three-point structure constants. We conjecture that the squares of the entries of the unitary F-matrix lie in a cyclotomic extension of the rational numbers. This enables us to convert our numerical estimates for the F-matrix into exact ones. The formalism is illustrated through numerous examples in Virasoro minimal models. We also discuss how these methods can be extended to cases involving symmetries that extend the Virasoro symmetry as well as for tenable examples that arise from the holomorphic modular bootstrap program.
summary:
我们开发了一种计算 RCFT 中四点函数编织矩阵的系统方法。这是针对 Virasoro 最小模型的情况实现的。共形块级数的前几项是通过 Shapovalov 形式直接计算的。三阶及更高阶的 Fuchsian (BPZ) ODE 具有通过这种直接计算固定的辅助参数。因此，我们绕过了从零状态条件的推导，这对于更高级别的零状态来说变得乏味。编织 F 矩阵是 ODE 两个奇异点处的 Frobenius 解之间的连接矩阵。首先对F矩阵进行数值计算，与Dotsenko-Fateev使用库仑气体形式主义的结果​​一致。我们发现，基数改变后，F 矩阵变得酉，这决定了三点结构常数（的乘积）。我们推测酉 F 矩阵的项的平方位于有理数的分圆扩张中。这使我们能够将 F 矩阵的数值估计转换为精确的估计。 Virasoro 最小模型中的大量例子说明了形式主义。

我们还讨论了如何将这些方法扩展到涉及扩展 Virasoro 对称性的对称性的情况，以及来自全纯模块化引导程序的可行示例。

title: Nonperturbative Chiral Anomaly Cancellation and Irrelevant Operators
abstract: The Chiral anomaly cancellation is perturbatively well understood but its nonperturbative validity in presence of a lattice has remained unproven. We provide a rigorous nonperturbative proof of anomaly cancellation and its universality in a variation of the lattice Kogut-Susskind regularization for the multiflavor Sommerfield model, describing Dirac fermions interacting with a non-compact $\mathrm{U}(1)$ quantum vector field. We identify a novel and general mechanism based on the convergence properties of the renormalized expansion and related to the one leading to universality in topological insulators. Irrelevant lattice operators, despite being suppressed along the RG flow, provide essential contributions to the anomaly cancellation.
summary: 手性异常消除在微扰方面已得到很好的理解，但其在存在晶格的情况下的非微扰有效性尚未得到证实。我们提供了异常消除的严格非微扰证明及其在多风味索默菲尔德模型的格子 Kogut-Susskind 正则化变体中的普遍性，描述了与非紧 $\mathrm{U}(1)$ 量子矢量场相互作用的狄拉克费米子。我们基于重正化展开的收敛特性确定了一种新颖且通用的机制，并且与导致拓扑绝缘体普遍性的机制相关。不相关的晶格算子尽管沿 RG 流被抑制，但对异常消除做出了重要贡献。

title: Explicit construction of the energy-momentum tensor in the large N limit of a four-Fermi theory
abstract: Using the exact renormalization group (functional RG) formalism, we construct the energy-momentum tensor of a four-Fermi theory in the Euclidean space of dimensions 2 < D < 4 in the large N limit, where N is the number of Dirac fields. The energy-momentum tensor is a functional of the Dirac fields, and its cutoff dependence is controlled by the exact RG equation. In the zero cutoff limit the functional reduces to the one-particle-irreducible effective action with a single insertion of the energy-momentum tensor. At a finite cutoff the energy-momentum tensor satisfies the Ward-Takahashi identity for translation invariance, and its antisymmetric part is determined by rotation invariance. We also show that the critical theory is conformally invariant by deriving the corresponding Ward-Takahashi identity.
summary: 使用精确重正化群（泛函 RG）形式，我们在大 N 极限下的维度 2 < D < 4 的欧几里得空间中构造了四费米理论的能量动量张量，其中 N 是狄拉克场的数量。能量动量张量是狄拉克场的函数，其截止依赖性由精确的 RG 方程控制。在零截止极限下，通过能量动量张量的单次插入，泛函可简化为单粒子不可约有效作用。在有限截止处，能量动量张量满足平移不变性的 Ward-Takahashi 恒等式，并且其反对称部分由旋转不变性确定。我们还通过推导相应的 Ward-Takahashi 恒等式来证明批判理论是保角不变的。

title: Supersymmetric boundary algebras in AdS$_3$ gravity: constraints, Dirac brackets and non-locality
abstract: We study supersymmetric boundary dynamics in AdS$_3$ gravity by treating boundary conditions as constrained reductions of a generic Chern-Simons boundary phase space. We focus on how the constraint structure controls the locality and physical field content of the reduced asymptotic symmetry algebra. For supersymmetric Kac--Moody boundary conditions, the surviving bosonic currents remain local, whereas the fermion--fermion Dirac bracket contains the inverse of a field-dependent first-order differential operator and is therefore intrinsically non-local. Imposing an additional fermionic constraint reveals a further structure: after the bosonic second-class reduction, it becomes first class and generates a fermionic gauge redundancy. Generically the remaining fermionic field can be gauged away, while special backgrounds with periodic zero modes support non-trivial physical fermionic sectors. We further employ the Batalin--Fradkin--Tyutin formalism to eliminate the non-locality of the reduced symmetry algebra by converting the second-class constraints into an equivalent local first-class system on an enlarged phase space.
summary: 我们通过将边界条件视为通用 Chern-Simons 边界相空间的约束约简来研究 AdS$_3$ 引力中的超对称边界动力学。我们关注约束结构如何控制约简渐近对称代数的局部性和物理场内容。对于超对称 Kac-Moody 边界条件，幸存的玻色子电流保持局部，而费米子-费米子狄拉克括号包含场相关一阶微分算子的逆，因此本质上是非局部的。施加额外的费米子约束揭示了进一步的结构：在玻色子二类约简之后，它变成一类并产生费米子规范冗余。一般来说，剩余的费米子场可以被测量出来，而具有周期性零模式的特殊背景支持非平凡的物理费米子扇区。我们进一步采用Batalin--Fradkin-Tyutin形式主义，通过将二类约束转换为扩大相空间上的等效局部一类系统来消除约化对称代数的非局部性。

title: Dirac oscillator in a self-gravitating cosmic string: confinement spectra beyond the conical approximation
abstract: The gravitational field of a physical cosmic string is regular on the axis, curved across a finite vortex core, and only asymptotically conical. We test whether the bound-state spectrum of a transverse Dirac oscillator resolves this structure beyond the ideal-cone approximation. The fermion is treated as a test field on self-consistent Einstein--Abelian-Higgs vortex backgrounds, and the radial problem is cast as a generalized Hermitian eigenvalue problem. The numerical formulation is checked against the exact Minkowski and ideal-cone spectra and by independent shooting calculations. For a reference vortex family, the finite-core correction grows from the weak-confinement regime toward the percent level. When the normalized asymptotic cone is held fixed, the spectrum still varies with the measured Higgs-core radius, and the sampled backgrounds bracket a change of sign of the ground-state correction. The bound-state spectrum therefore contains information about the resolved core profiles that is not fixed by the asymptotic cone alone.
summary: 物理宇宙弦的引力场在轴上是规则的，在有限的涡核上弯曲，并且只是渐近圆锥形。我们测试了横向狄拉克振荡器的束缚态谱是否能够超越理想锥近似解析该结构。费米子被视为自洽爱因斯坦-阿贝尔-希格斯涡旋背景的测试场，径向问题被视为广义厄米特征值问题。数值公式根据精确的闵可夫斯基和理想锥体光谱以及独立的射击计算进行检查。对于参考涡旋族，有限核心修正从弱约束状态向百分比水平增长。当归一化渐进锥保持固定时，光谱仍然随着测量的希格斯核心半径而变化，并且采样的背景包含基态校正的符号变化。因此，束缚态谱包含有关已解析的核心轮廓的信息，该信息不能单独由渐近锥固定。

title: Learning the Emergent Bulk Geometry of the Three Dimensional Ising Model
abstract: We use Monte Carlo data for the three-dimensional Ising model at the critical temperature to predict an emergent radial geometry of the bulk using machine learning. Specifically, we employ a differentiable solver for a probe field on an asymptotically $\mathrm{AdS}_4$ background, trained to reproduce the measured momentum-space two-point functions of the boundary operators ($\sigma$ and $\epsilon$). We find that a single metric cannot simultaneously serve both operators. Fitting each channel separately improves its own residual by a factor of three to five, but degrades the other by up to two orders of magnitude. We quantify this tension between the two operators and show that it survives changes to the momentum window and the lattice size. Our results numerically demonstrate that the bulk geometry of a theory with an $\mathcal{O}(1)$ central charge, such as the 3D Ising model, is not captured by a single classical metric.
summary: 我们使用临界温度下三维伊辛模型的蒙特卡罗数据，通过机器学习来预测块体的新兴径向几何形状。具体来说，我们在渐近 $\mathrm{AdS}_4$ 背景上对探测场采用可微分求解器，经过训练可以重现边界算子（$\sigma$ 和 $\epsilon$）的测量动量空间两点函数。我们发现单个指标无法同时服务于两个运营商。单独拟合每个通道可以将其自身的残差提高三到五倍，但会使另一个通道的残差降低最多两个数量级。我们量化了两个算子之间的这种张力，并表明它能够承受动量窗口和晶格尺寸的变化。我们的结果在数值上证明了具有 $\mathcal{O}(1)$ 中心电荷的理论的整体几何结构，例如 3D Ising 模型，不能由单个经典度量来捕获。

title: The Page Transition in the Multi-Time Correlations of Hawking Radiation
abstract: The Page curve and the island formula describe a reorganization of quantum information in Hawking radiation across the Page time. We study how this reorganization appears in correlations among emissions collected at several retarded times. The late radiation is treated as a covariant multi-time process, or process tensor, and $\chi_{\mathrm{island}}=\mathcal{N}_{\varnothing}-\mathcal{N}_{R}$ measures the temporal memory removed when the early radiation register $R$ is supplied. Operationally, this quantity is the corresponding change in the optimal distinguishability of the radiation process from a Markovian reference. We exhibit evaporation processes whose single-bin states and all process marginals below a finite order $k_\ast\geq 3$ remain fixed and coincide with a CP-divisible reference, while $\chi_{\mathrm{island}}$ changes by order one at order $k_\ast$. The Page transition can therefore appear as a transition in the Markov order of the radiation process. When the interior mediates the late-time memory, entanglement-wedge reconstruction of the predictive interior from $R$ Markovianizes the late process; conversely, when the late process has a minimal predictive memory and its future-affecting information is mediated by that memory, Markovianization by $R$ supplies a simulator of its influence. A Hayden--Preskill evaporation comb and an evaporating-JT calculation realize this mechanism. The late radiation retains temporal memory across the transition, while the early radiation becomes sufficient for predicting its future multi-time statistics.
summary:
佩吉曲线和岛公式描述了霍金辐射在佩吉时间内量子信息的重组。我们研究了这种重组如何出现在几个延迟时间收集的排放量之间的相关性中。晚期辐射被视为协变多时间过程或过程张量，并且 $\chi_{\mathrm{island}}=\mathcal{N}_{\varnothing}-\mathcal{N}_{R}$ 测量提供早期辐射寄存器 $R$ 时删除的时间记忆。在操作上，这个量是辐射过程与马尔可夫参考的最佳区分度的相应变化。我们展示了蒸发过程，其单箱状态和低于有限阶 $k_\ast\geq 3$ 的所有过程边际保持固定并与 CP 可整除参考一致，而 $\chi_{\mathrm{island}}$ 在阶 $k_\ast$ 处按阶一变化。因此，页面转变可以表现为辐射过程的马尔可夫阶中的转变。

当内部调节后期记忆时，从 $R$ 马尔可夫化后期过程中预测内部的纠缠楔形重建；相反，当后期过程具有最小的预测记忆并且其影响未来的信息由该记忆调节时，$R$ 的马尔可夫化提供了其影响的模拟器。 Hayden--Preskill 蒸发梳和蒸发-JT 计算实现了这一机制。晚期辐射保留了整个转变过程中的时间记忆，而早期辐射足以预测其未来的多时间统计数据。

title: Four-Point Yang-Mills Correlators in AdS$_4$ from All-Line Recursion: All-Plus, Single-Minus and MHV
abstract: We review Raju's all-line recursion relations for Yang-Mills theory in AdS${}_4$ and evaluate four-point correlators for the All-plus, Single-minus, and MHV helicity configurations. We point out the relevant deformation for the legs needed to obtain the correlators. In particular, we explicitly derive the expressions for all the residues contributing to all three correlators. We also perform an explicit numerical check with the results computed by Witten diagram computations and find perfect agreement with our results. Finally, we conclude by discussing some applications of these recursions for obtaining higher-point functions.
summary: 我们回顾 AdS${}_4$ 中 Yang-Mills 理论的 Raju 全线递归关系，并评估全加、单减和 MHV 螺旋配置的四点相关器。我们指出获得相关器所需的腿的相关变形。特别是，我们明确地推导了对所有三个相关器有贡献的所有残基的表达式。我们还对威滕图计算的结果进行了明确的数值检查，并发现与我们的结果完全一致。最后，我们通过讨论这些递归来获得更高点函数的一些应用作为结论。

title: Holographic correlators with non-supersymmetric multi-particle states
abstract: We consider heavy-heavy-light-light (HHLL) holographic correlators in which the heavy states are coherent superpositions of $n$-particle operators. In the limit of large $n$ and large central charge, $c$, with $n/c$ held fixed, these HHLL correlators are described by a classical supergravity computation. When the multi-particle operators are half-BPS, it has been shown that the $n/c\to 0$ limit of the HHLL correlator encodes the tree-level connected contribution to the 4-point function with the heavy operators replaced by two $n$-particle operators with finite $n$. We provide evidence that this relation continues to hold when the multi-particle operators are non-supersymmetric. Although our checks are carried out in the AdS$_3$/CFT$_2$ setting, we expect that our conjecture extends to more general holographic dualities.
summary: 我们考虑重-重-轻-轻（HHLL）全息相关器，其中重态是 $n$ 粒子算子的相干叠加。在大 $n$ 和大中心电荷 $c$ 的限制下，$n/c$ 保持固定，这些 HHLL 相关器通过经典超重力计算来描述。当多粒子算子是半 BPS 时，已经表明，HHLL 相关器的 $n/c\to 0$ 限制编码了对 4 点函数的树级连接贡献，其中重算子被两个具有有限 $n$ 的 $n$ 粒子算子替换。我们提供的证据表明，当多粒子算子是非超对称时，这种关系继续成立。尽管我们的检查是在 AdS$_3$/CFT$_2$ 设置下进行的，但我们期望我们的猜想扩展到更一般的全息二元性。

title: New Bethe vacua for $\mathcal{N}=2$ elliptic models
abstract: We study the superconformal index of four-dimensional $\mathcal{N}=2$ $\mathrm{SU}(N)$ elliptic models through the Bethe Ansatz approach, where the index is evaluated as a sum of vacua arising from a set of transcendental equations. Starting from the known discrete solutions of these equations, that we refer to as progenitors, we show that there exist large classes of new descendant solutions. We then show that the solutions can be organized into orbits of the S-duality group, mimicking its action on the massive vacua of the $\mathcal{N}=1^*$ deformations of the elliptic spin Calogero-Moser models. In this way we generalize the results already obtained for $\mathcal{N}=4$ $\mathrm{SU}(N)$ SYM, where a relation between the discrete solutions to the Bethe Ansatz Equations and the massive vacua of its $\mathcal{N}=1^*$ massive deformation was conjectured. We conclude our analysis by determining the contributions of the new descendant solutions to the index.
summary: 我们通过 Bethe Ansatz 方法研究四维 $\mathcal{N}=2$ $\mathrm{SU}(N)$ 椭圆模型的超共形指数，其中该指数被评估为由一组超越方程产生的真空之和。从这些方程的已知离散解（我们称为祖先）开始，我们证明存在大量新的后代解。然后，我们证明这些解可以组织成 S 对偶群的轨道，模仿其对椭圆自旋 Calogero-Moser 模型的 $\mathcal{N}=1^*$ 变形的巨大真空的作用。通过这种方式，我们概括了 $\mathcal{N}=4$ $\mathrm{SU}(N)$ SYM 已经获得的结果，其中推测了 Bethe Ansatz 方程的离散解与其 $\mathcal{N}=1^*$ 大规模变形的大规模真空之间的关系。我们通过确定新的后代解决方案对索引的贡献来结束我们的分析。

title: Exploring multi-parameter optimization in FRG
abstract: The use of nonperturbative Wilsonian functional renormalization group (FRG) equations within an unavoidable approximation scheme produces physical results that depend on the choice of the coarse-graining regulator. This dependence of physical observables on the regulator can be minimized according to the principle of minimal sensitivity (PMS). For the 1PI formulation based on the Wetterich-Morris equation, we propose to investigate the optimal choice within a space of compactly supported polynomial regulators parametrized by a set of variables. We test this approach using the derivative expansion of the effective average action up to fourth order, applying it to the scalar field theory representing the three-dimensional Ising universality class and minimizing the dependence of the anomalous dimension on the regulator. At fourth order, we find appreciable corrections to the critical exponents that improve the predictions, compared to previous one parameter analyses. We also observe families of compact regulators that rapidly converge towards an optimal functional form as a small number of parameters is progressively introduced.
summary: 在不可避免的近似方案中使用非微扰威尔逊函数重正化群 (FRG) 方程会产生取决于粗粒度调节器选择的物理结果。 This dependence of physical observables on the regulator can be minimized according to the principle of minimal sensitivity (PMS).对于基于 Wetterich-Morris 方程的 1PI 公式，我们建议研究由一组变量参数化的紧支持多项式调节器空间内的最优选择。我们使用有效平均作用的导数展开到四阶来测试这种方法，将其应用于表示三维伊辛普适性类的标量场理论，并最小化异常维度对调节器的依赖性。与之前的一个参数分析相比，在第四阶，我们发现对关键指数进行了明显的修正，从而改善了预测。我们还观察到随着少量参数的逐步引入，紧凑型调节器家族迅速收敛到最佳功能形式。

title: Young Gerard storming high energy physics
abstract: On the occasion of Gerard 't Hooft's 80th birthday, I present my personal recollections of a scientific meeting held in the Orsay Campus of the University of Paris in January 1972. In this meeting Gerard gave for the first time a detailed account of his groundbreaking work on the renormalization properties of Yang-Mills theories, both in the massless phase as well as in the phase with spontaneous symmetry breaking.
summary: 值此杰拉德·特霍夫特 80 岁生日之际，我向您介绍我对 1972 年 1 月在巴黎大学奥赛校区举行的一次科学会议的个人回忆。在这次会议上，杰拉德首次详细介绍了他在杨-米尔斯理论的重正化性质方面的开创性工作，包括无质量相和自发对称破缺相。

title: Toward a Unique Filter for the Gravitational Path Integral
abstract: In recent work, McNamara and Wang demonstrated that the failure of factorization for a gravitational path integral (GPI) can be understood as an incompleteness of its spectrum of states by constructing a unitary quantum field theory (QFT) into which the GPI embeds. We examine this construction from an algebraic point of view, and use it to verify a conjecture of the author concerning the existence and uniqueness of a unitary completion for the GPI by means of the theory of conditional expectations. We explore how the unitary QFT can be regarded as a single coherent theory in which the quantitative signatures of ensemble averaging emerge purely from projecting to the underlying, smooth GPI. The conditional expectation relating the two theories may therefore be interpreted as a filter in the sense of Liu. The factorizing theory differs from a more standard QFT in the sense that it is reducible, meaning the Hilbert space associated with the empty set is non-trivial. We explain how the structure of reducible QFTs are generically encoded in weak Hopf algebraic symmetries and demonstrate how the weak structure allows for generalized $\alpha$-sectors and half wormholes to coexist within a single Hilbert space.
summary:
在最近的工作中，McNamara 和 Wang 通过构建嵌入 GPI 的酉量子场论 (QFT)，证明了引力路径积分 (GPI) 因式分解的失败可以理解为其状态谱的不完整性。我们从代数的角度来检验这个构造，并用它通过条件期望理论来验证作者关于GPI的酉完备性的存在性和唯一性的猜想。我们探讨了如何将酉 QFT 视为一个单一的连贯理论，其中集合平均的定量特征纯粹是通过投影到底层的平滑 GPI 而出现的。因此，与这两种理论相关的条件期望可以被解释为刘意义上的过滤器。因式分解理论与更标准的 QFT 的不同之处在于它是可简化的，这意味着与空集相关的希尔伯特空间是不平凡的。

我们解释了可约 QFT 的结构如何一般编码为弱 Hopf 代数对称性，并演示弱结构如何允许广义 $\alpha$ 扇区和半虫洞在单个希尔伯特空间中共存。

title: Environmental Effects in Post-Minkowskian Dynamics: Effective Field Theory, Feynman Rules, and Ward Identities for Compact Objects in Relativistic Fluids
abstract: We develop a hydrodynamic effective field theory for the gravitational dynamics of compact objects moving through an inviscid fluid environment. The fluid is described by the effective theory of perfect fluids, whose Goldstone phonons are kept as explicit fields coupled to gravity. We establish a consistent power counting for the resulting Feynman rules and derive the propagators and interaction vertices through four points in $D$ dimensions, together with the generalized on-shell Ward identities they obey. These identities relate amplitudes with an external graviton to those with the graviton replaced by a phonon, and thus provide nontrivial checks on higher-order calculations. As an application, we recover the leading-order relativistic dynamical-friction force from the tree-level amplitude for single-phonon emission. This work is a first step towards a toolkit for incorporating environmental effects into the scattering-amplitude pipeline used in post-Minkowskian calculations.
summary: 我们开发了一种流体动力学有效场理论，用于研究在无粘性流体环境中移动的致密物体的重力动力学。该流体由完美流体的有效理论描述，其戈德斯通声子被保持为与重力耦合的显式场。我们为由此产生的费曼规则建立了一致的幂计数，并通过 $D$ 维度中的四个点导出传播子和交互顶点，以及它们遵循的广义壳上 Ward 恒等式。这些恒等式将外部引力子的振幅与用声子代替引力子的振幅联系起来，从而为高阶计算提供了重要的检查。作为一个应用，我们从单声子发射的树级振幅中恢复了前序相对论动力摩擦力。这项工作是将环境影响纳入后闵可夫斯基计算中使用的散射幅度管道的工具包的第一步。

title: Looking inside a quantum black hole
abstract: Quantum effects are expected to modify a black hole's interior structure, particularly near the singularity. We show how to extract the scaling exponent of the singularity from the quasinormal mode (QNM) spectrum of a massless scalar probe in the asymptotic large-overtone limit. We apply our method to a family of exact quantum black holes in (2+1)-dimensional anti-de Sitter (AdS) space and explicitly uncover a transition deep in the interior when quantum effects become dominant.
summary: 量子效应预计会改变黑洞的内部结构，特别是在奇点附近。我们展示了如何在渐近大泛音极限下从无质量标量探针的拟正态模式（QNM）谱中提取奇点的标度指数。我们将我们的方法应用于 (2+1) 维反德西特 (AdS) 空间中的一系列精确量子黑洞，并明确揭示了当量子效应占主导地位时内部深处的转变。

title: M2-brane matrix models and Fermi gas on affine ABCD quivers
abstract: We study a new class of M2-brane matrix models associated with affine BC and twisted affine AD quivers. These models exhibit the characteristic $N^{3/2}$ scaling of the free energy in the large $N$ limit. We establish a Fermi gas formalism and demonstrate that their grand canonical sum is given by a Fredholm Pfaffian, which is in parallel with the affine D quiver matrix models. The resulting Fermi gas density matrix shows a rational dependence on the canonical position/momentum operators in addition to the standard hyperbolic dependence. This leads to unconventional sub-leading corrections, which obstruct the Airy function structure in the $1/N$ expansion of the free energy observed in the previously studied M2-brane matrix models.
summary: 我们研究了一类与仿射 BC 和扭曲仿射 AD 颤动相关的新型 M2 膜矩阵模型。这些模型表现出在大 $N$ 限制下自由能的特征 $N^{3/2}$ 缩放。我们建立了费米气体形式并证明了它们的大正则和由 Fredholm Pfaffian 给出，与仿射 D 箭袋矩阵模型并行。所得的费米气体密度矩阵除了标准双曲线依赖性之外还显示出对规范位置/动量算子的理性依赖性。这导致了非常规的次领先修正，阻碍了先前研究的 M2 膜矩阵模型中观察到的自由能 $1/N$ 展开中的艾里函数结构。

title: Three-Dimensional Coulomb Discrete Spectrum via Symplectic Geometry and Phase-Space Constraints: A Geometric Framework for Condensed-Matter Coulomb-Like Systems
abstract: Discrete energy-level structures in Coulomb-like localized bound states are conventionally obtained by direct diagonalization of the Schrödinger equation or by semiclassical approximations that fail at low energies. Here we develop a geometric phase-space framework that recovers the exact discrete energy levels and shell degeneracy of three-dimensional Coulomb bound states from classical symplectic geometry and global boundary constraints, bypassing explicit operator diagonalization. Using Kustaanheimo--Stiefel regularization, we map negative-energy Kepler orbits to four-dimensional isotropic harmonic oscillators. The group composition law of the symplectic flow determines an integral kernel built from the classical two-point action and Van Vleck amplitude, whose infinitesimal generator satisfies an exact linear evolution equation---a property we term \textit{quadratic closure}. Imposing three geometric constraints---decay at infinity, regularity at the origin, and fiber invariance under the Hopf fibration---we recover the exact $E_n/E_1=1/n^2$ scaling and $g_n=n^2$ degeneracy. The phase scale $\alpha$ sets the action unit; all spectral structural features are independent of its value. This framework offers a symmetry-transparent route to spectral data: for quadratic Hamiltonians, the classical kernel incurs zero semiclassical error even at ground-state energies, and the geometric constraints directly identify symmetry-protected degeneracies without diagonalization. We apply the method to shallow impurity states, moiré superlattices, and semiclassical transport, demonstrating how geometric screening rules simplify spectral analysis in condensed-matter environments.
summary:
类库仑定域束缚态的离散能级结构通常是通过薛定谔方程的直接对角化或通过在低能量下失效的半经典近似来获得的。在这里，我们开发了一个几何相空间框架，可以从经典辛几何和全局边界约束中恢复三维库仑束缚态的精确离散能级和壳简并性，绕过显式算子对角化。使用 Kustaan​​heimo-Stiefel 正则化，我们将负能量开普勒轨道映射到四维各向同性谐振子。辛流的群合成律决定了由经典两点作用和 Van Vleck 振幅构建的积分核，其无穷小生成元满足精确的线性演化方程——我们称之为 \textit{二次闭包} 的性质。施加三个几何约束——无穷远衰减、原点规律性和 Hopf 纤维下的纤维不变性——我们恢复了精确的 $E_n/E_1=1/n^2$ 缩放和 $g_n=n^2$ 简并性。

相位尺度$\alpha$设置动作单位；所有光谱结构特征与其值无关。该框架为光谱数据提供了对称透明的途径：对于二次哈密顿量，经典核即使在基态能量下也会产生零半经典误差，并且几何约束直接识别对称保护的简并性而无需对角化。我们将该方法应用于浅杂质态、莫尔超晶格和半经典输运，展示了几何筛选规则如何简化凝聚态环境中的光谱分析。

title: The spectral $ζ$-function of Sturm--Liouville operators with $N$ generalized point potentials
abstract: This work analyzes the spectral zeta function associated with regular and singular Sturm--Liouville operators endowed with $N$ generalized point potentials. The point interactions are characterized as a particular class of self-adjoint extensions of Sturm--Liouville operators defined on a chain of $N+1$ adjacent intervals. Each interaction is described by $SL(2,\R)$ matching conditions relating generalized boundary values across neighboring intervals. We construct the spectral zeta function associated with Sturm--Liouville operators endowed with $N$ generalized point potentials in terms of a contour integral involving an appropriate characteristic function. The process of analytic continuation of the spectral zeta function to a neighborhood of the origin is illustrated by means of specific examples where the $\zeta$-regularized functional determinant is also explicitly computed.
summary: 这项工作分析了与赋予 $N$ 广义点势的正则和奇异 Sturm--Liouville 算子相关的谱 zeta 函数。点相互作用的特征是在 $N+1$ 相邻区间链上定义的 Sturm--Liouville 算子的一类特定的自伴扩展。每个交互都由与相邻区间的广义边界值相关的 $SL(2,\R)$ 匹配条件来描述。我们构造了与 Sturm--Liouville 算子相关的谱 zeta 函数，该算子根据涉及适当特征函数的轮廓积分赋予了 $N$ 广义点势。通过具体示例说明了光谱 zeta 函数到原点邻域的解析延拓过程，其中还显式计算了 $\zeta$ 正则化函数行列式。

title: Site-scale, Multi-resolution WRF Wind Modeling with Observational Nudging for Methane Emission Monitoring in the Permian Basin
abstract: Accurate methane source localization and emission-rate estimation at oil and gas facilities require wind fields that resolve site-scale spatial and temporal variability, which cannot be characterized by a single anemometer or coarse operational weather products. We develop a multiscale Weather Research and Forecasting (WRF) framework for a Permian Basin facility that dynamically downscales hourly, 3 km High-Resolution Rapid Refresh (HRRR) fields through four nested domains with grid spacings of 3 km, 1 km, 200 m, and 40 m. The two outer domains use planetary-boundary-layer parameterization, whereas the two inner domains operate in large-eddy-simulation mode. One-minute wind observations from two on-site anemometers are assimilated through wind-only observational nudging in the innermost domain, and the effects of nesting feedback and turbulence-closure choices are examined. Simulations for winter and summer 2025 periods are evaluated using near-surface wind-speed time series, power spectra, spatial fields, and statistical metrics. The baseline simulation reproduces the broad evolution of observed wind events but drifts during weak-wind periods. Observational nudging with one- and two-way nesting reduces the absolute bias of wind-speed by %65 at one sensor and %87 at the other, while reducing the corresponding root-mean-square errors by %33 and %44. Nudging also increases high-frequency energy and resolved spatial gradients, although improvements in turbulence statistics are not uniform. These results demonstrate a practical physics-based pathway for generating high-resolution wind fields for methane-plume modeling while emphasizing the need for independent spatial observations to validate accuracy away from assimilated sensors.
summary:
石油和天然气设施的准确甲烷源定位和排放率估算需要风场来解决场地尺度的空间和时间变化，而这些变化无法通过单个风速计或粗略的业务天气产品来表征。我们为二叠纪盆地设施开发了一个多尺度天气研究和预报 (WRF) 框架，该框架通过网格间距为 3 km、1 km、200 m 和 40 m 的四个嵌套域动态缩小每小时 3 km 高分辨率快速刷新 (HRRR) 字段的规模。两个外部域使用行星边界层参数化，而两个内部域以大涡模拟模式运行。来自两个现场风速计的一分钟风观测通过最内域的仅风观测推动进行同化，并检查嵌套反馈和湍流闭合选择的影响。使用近地表风速时间序列、功率谱、空间场和统计指标评估 2025 年冬季和夏季的模拟。基线模拟再现了观测到的风事件的广泛演变，但在弱风时期发生了漂移。

采用单向和双向嵌套的观测微移可将一个传感器的风速绝对偏差降低 65%，另一个传感器的风速绝对偏差降低 87%，同时将相应的均方根误差降低 %33 和 %44。尽管湍流统计数据的改进并不均匀，但轻推还增加了高频能量和解析的空间梯度。这些结果展示了一种基于物理的实用途径，用于生成用于甲烷羽流建模的高分辨率风场，同时强调需要独立的空间观测来验证远离同化传感器的准确性。

title: Boundary parity in the mirror model on the Manhattan lattice
abstract: We study a finite-domain event for the mirror model on the Manhattan lattice: every boundary-to-boundary trajectory crosses a marked connector an even number of times, while internal cycles are unrestricted. Our main theorem gives a finite-scale confinement criterion: if this event's probability reaches a universal threshold in one even two-square rectangle, then almost surely every trajectory in the plane is periodic. We construct an exactly normalized three-color tensor representation and prove deterministic bounds for approximate contractions using the signed partial-permutation structure of directed continuations. These tools turn numerical evaluations into rigorous finite-volume statements. At mirror density \(p=2/5\), we prove that the boundary-parity probability is nonmonotone in the rectangle width, with a decrease followed by a certified increase. These values remain below the sufficient confinement threshold and do not resolve planar localization at this density. Further experiments track how the measured finite-size minimum varies with density, compare matching-based and entrywise error bounds, and exhibit endpoint-sensitive and cooperative responses to local mirror changes.
summary:
我们研究曼哈顿晶格上镜像模型的有限域事件：每个边界到边界的轨迹都穿过标记的连接器偶数次，而内部循环不受限制。我们的主要定理给出了一个有限尺度的限制标准：如果该事件的概率在一个偶数两个正方形矩形中达到通用阈值，那么几乎可以肯定该平面上的每个轨迹都是周期性的。我们构造了一个精确归一化的三色张量表示，并使用有向连续的有符号部分排列结构证明了近似收缩的确定性界限。这些工具将数值评估转化为严格的有限体积语句。在镜像密度 \(p=2/5\) 下，我们证明边界奇偶校验概率在矩形宽度上是非单调的，先减小后增大。这些值仍然低于足够的限制阈值，并且不能解决该密度下的平面定位问题。

进一步的实验跟踪测量的有限尺寸最小值如何随密度变化，比较基于匹配和条目的误差界限，并展示对局部镜像变化的端点敏感和协作响应。

title: Eberlein convolution as an inner product and quantitative Bombieri--Taylor results
abstract: We present a simple argument providing a very general Bombieri--Taylor-type result to compute Bragg peaks in diffraction theory as limits. At its abstract core the argument relies on considering the Eberlein convolution as an inner product. This inner product gives an abstract version of a Cauchy--Schwarz type inequality which implies the Bombieri--Taylor-type result as well as generalizations.
summary: 我们提出了一个简单的论证，提供了一个非常普遍的邦别里-泰勒型结果来计算衍射理论中的布拉格峰作为极限。在其抽象核心上，该论证依赖于将 Eberlein 卷积视为内积。该内积给出了 Cauchy-Schwarz 型不等式的抽象版本，它暗示了 Bombieri-Taylor 型结果以及概括。

title: A c-transform optimal transport method for high-contrast freeform reflector design
abstract: Design of high-contrast freeform reflectors is challenging, as the presence of zero-intensity regions leads to degeneracy in the associated Monge-Ampere-type equation. A common remedy is to add a positive artificial background to the target intensity, which improves the regularity of the equation. However, this regularization inevitably reduces the achievable illumination contrast and introduces nonzero intensity into regions that are intended to remain dark. We propose a fast c-transform method based on optimal transport duality for high-contrast freeform reflector design in the far field without artificial background regularization. The method integrates repeated discrete c-transforms into a measure-based dual optimization scheme to maintain the c-concavity of the reflector potential throughout the iteration. This preserves the admissibility of the iterates and enables stable convergence for targets with zero-intensity regions. To efficiently compute the discrete c-transforms, we develop a localized search algorithm that exploits their contact structure and prove its exactness and linear complexity. Numerical experiments demonstrate that the proposed method accurately realizes high-contrast illumination targets with zero background.
summary:
高对比度自由形状反射器的设计具有挑战性，因为零强度区域的存在会导致相关蒙日-安培型方程的简并性。常见的补救措施是向目标强度添加正的人工背景，从而提高方程的规律性。然而，这种正则化不可避免地会降低可实现的照明对比度，并将非零强度引入旨在保持黑暗的区域。我们提出了一种基于最佳传输对偶性的快速 c 变换方法，用于远场高对比度自由形状反射器设计，无需人工背景正则化。该方法将重复的离散 c 变换集成到基于测量的双优化方案中，以在整个迭代过程中保持反射器势的 c 凹性。这保留了迭代的可接受性，并使具有零强度区域的目标能够稳定收敛。为了有效地计算离散 c 变换，我们开发了一种局部搜索算法，该算法利用它们的接触结构并证明其准确性和线性复杂度。

数值实验表明，该方法能够准确实现零背景的高对比度照明目标。

title: Contact Large Deviations of Stochastic Vector Bundles
abstract: Large deviation theory lacks a geometric foundation for its rate functions and fluctuation symmetries. This paper develops a contact large deviation theory on stochastic vector bundles, in which the rate function, the scaled cumulant generating function, and a Gallavotti--Cohen-type fluctuation duality all follow from the contact 1-form. The constraint function acts as a generalized Lagrangian; the least constraint principle yields the dynamics, and the contact potential is built order by order from the master equation, producing a coupled Hamilton--Jacobi--transport system governed by the invariant density, drift, and fluctuation tensor. The contact path measure satisfies a large deviation principle with rate function given by the constraint action; the scaled cumulant generating function obeys a stationary eigenvalue equation with a Donsker--Varadhan variational characterization. The entropy production rate, the fluctuation--dissipation combination $e=\tfrac12 g^T Ag-\sigma$, is the physical observable; the time-reversal involution $J:(t,y,\phi)\mapsto(t,y,-\phi-\nabla\ln\rho)$ with reversed drift $v^{\mathrm{rev}}=-v+Ag$ yields a Gallavotti--Cohen-type duality $\lambda_{\mathrm{fwd}}(q)=\lambda_{\mathrm{rev}}(q+1)+\lambda_{\mathrm{fwd}}(-1)$. The classical one-dimensional GC symmetry is recovered in the reversible case $Ag=0$.
summary:
大偏差理论缺乏其速率函数和涨落对称性的几何基础。本文提出了一种关于随机向量丛的接触大偏差理论，其中速率函数、缩放累积量生成函数和Gallavotti-Cohen型涨落对偶性均遵循接触1-形式。约束函数充当广义拉格朗日函数；最小约束原理产生动力学，并且接触势从主方程中按顺序建立，产生由不变密度、漂移和涨落张量控制的耦合汉密尔顿-雅可比-输运系统。接触路径测度与约束作用给出的速率函数满足大偏差原理；缩放累积量生成函数服从具有 Donsker--Varadhan 变分特征的平稳特征值方程。

熵产生率，涨落-耗散组合$e=\tfrac12 g^T Ag-\sigma$，是物理可观测量；时间反转对合 $J:(t,y,\phi)\mapsto(t,y,-\phi-\nabla\ln\rho)$ 与反向漂移 $v^{\mathrm{rev}}=-v+Ag$ 产生 Gallavotti--Cohen 型对偶$\lambda_{\mathrm{fwd}}(q)=\lambda_{\mathrm{rev}}(q+1)+\lambda_{\mathrm{fwd}}(-1)$。在可逆情况 $Ag=0$ 中恢复了经典的一维 GC 对称性。

title: Reconstructability of Inverse Problems under Symmetry: Separating Structural, Effective, and Physical Upper Bounds
abstract: In our previous work we introduced the Reconstruction Dimension, an upper bound on the reconstructable degrees of freedom determined solely by the symmetry. In actual physical systems, however, the state quantities are generated through physical processes $P_o$ induced by the cause $O$. The state space is therefore often degenerate, and the upper bound determined by the representation-theoretic structure is not reached. This calls for a distinction between the upper bound determined solely by symmetry and the one realized after the physical process. We therefore introduce a three-level structure of upper bounds: the Structural, Effective, and Physical Reconstruction Dimensions (SRD, ERD, PRD), determined respectively by the representation-theoretic structure of the intermediate space, by the concrete design of the reconstruction map, and by the degeneracy of the state space under the physical process $P_o$. For each irreducible component they form the hierarchy $\mathrm{SRD}\ge\mathrm{ERD}\ge\mathrm{PRD}$, so that the two gaps identify at which level reconstructability is lost. The framework is illustrated through two contrasting systems: the orientation dynamics of flake-like particles, where the cause is a velocity gradinet, and the two-body problem, where the cause itself is defined through the symmetry. This paper provides a concrete framework for reconstruction in physical inverse problems.
summary:
在我们之前的工作中，我们引入了重建维数，这是仅由对称性决定的可重建自由度的上限。然而，在实际的物理系统中，状态量是通过原因$O$引发的物理过程$P_o$产生的。因此，状态空间常常是退化的，并且未达到由表示理论结构确定的上限。这就需要区分仅由对称性确定的上限和物理过程后实现的上限。因此，我们引入了上界的三级结构：结构、有效和物理重构维度（SRD、ERD、PRD），分别由中间空间的表示理论结构、重构图的具体设计以及物理过程$P_o$下状态空间的简并性决定。对于每个不可约分量，它们形成层次结构 $\mathrm{SRD}\ge\mathrm{ERD}\ge\mathrm{PRD}$，以便这两个间隙确定在哪个级别丢失了可重构性。

该框架通过两个对比系统进行说明：片状粒子的取向动力学（其中原因是速度梯度）和二体问题（其中原因本身是通过对称性定义的）。本文为物理反问题的重构提供了一个具体的框架。

title: Classification of pairs of second-order Hamiltonian operators and hydrodynamic type systems in six components
abstract: Following a recent characterisation of hydrodynamic systems with second-order Hamiltonian structure in terms of alternating three-forms on the projective space, we present a complete classification of systems in 6 components. We use non-trivial group action techniques to obtain 5 canonical forms. A general result for every dimension is also obtained for one of these cases, whose geometric structure is strictly related to the symplectic canonical form.
summary: 根据最近在射影空间上交替三种形式的二阶哈密顿结构流体动力系统的表征，我们提出了 6 个组件的系统的完整分类。我们使用非平凡的群体行动技术来获得 5 种规范形式。对于其中一种情况，也获得了每个维度的一般结果，其几何结构与辛正则形式严格相关。

title: A Cumulative Framework for Solid Deformation
abstract: A cumulative variational framework for solid deformation is proposed. Its central organizing principle is the recursive combination of three structural components of one material body: a compatible Cosserat component, a distributed-incompatibility component, and a defect-source component. At any prescribed external condition these components constitute a combined material state. They are governed under common physical boundary and initial conditions and are coupled through one cumulative energy and the associated field equations. They are not separate boundary-value problems and need not appear in a prescribed temporal sequence. The cumulative character of the framework concerns the response of the combined state to variation of externally prescribed conditions. For the special case of an initially perfect body, loss of stability may produce successive branches with defect and then source participation. Such a sequence is a bifurcation property of the selected initial state and constitutive energy, rather than a defining hierarchy of the framework. A one-dimensional specialization illustrates structural bifurcation, residual deformation and residual stress produced by retained structure, dependence on the initial combined state, directional memory under reverse loading, parametric cumulative hysteresis, and changes of observable tangent stiffness associated with structural stabilization. A spatial extension introduces defect and source gradient terms and yields a size-dependent structural stability operator. For the stable quartic energy considered, the gradient terms regularize nonuniform perturbations but do not by themselves generate a finite-wavelength localization instability on an already stable three-component branch. The examples thereby distinguish consequences of the cumulative structure and energy from phenomena requiring additional constitutive evolution laws.
summary:
提出了固体变形的累积变分框架。其中心组织原则是一个物质体的三个结构组件的递归组合：兼容 Cosserat 组件、分布式不兼容组件和缺陷源组件。在任何规定的外部条件下，这些成分构成了组合的材料状态。它们受共同的物理边界和初始条件控制，并通过一个累积能量和相关的场方程耦合。它们不是单独的边界值问题，也不需要以规定的时间顺序出现。框架的累积特征涉及组合状态对外部规定条件变化的响应。对于最初完美的身体的特殊情况，稳定性的丧失可能会产生连续的有缺陷的分支，然后产生源参与。这样的序列是所选初始状态和本构能量的分叉特性，而不是框架的定义层次结构。

一维特化说明了结构分叉、保留结构产生的残余变形和残余应力、对初始组合状态的依赖性、反向载荷下的方向记忆、参数累积滞后以及与结构稳定性相关的可观察到的切向刚度的变化。空间扩展引入了缺陷和源梯度项，并产生了依赖于尺寸的结构稳定性算子。对于所考虑的稳定四次能量，梯度项正则化非均匀扰动，但其本身不会在已经稳定的三分量分支上产生有限波长局域化不稳定性。因此，这些例子将累积结构和能量的结果与需要额外的本构演化定律的现象区分开来。

title: Asymmetric phase transitions in random noncommutative geometries
abstract: In this paper, we study the asymmetric phases of the quartic type (0, 1) and (1, 0) Dirac en- sembles via three approaches: the Riemann-Hilbert approach, bootstrapping with positivity, and Hamiltonian Monte Carlo (HMC) simulations. The focus of this work is on asymmetric solutions to the Schwinger-Dyson and saddle point equations of these models, whose solution spaces prove deeply intricate. Via the Riemann-Hilbert approach, we are able to give explicit formulae for the eigenvalue distributions and free energy of various solutions. Using Hamiltonian Monte Carlo simulations, we are able to reconstruct the phase structure. Lastly, using bootstrapping with positivity, we are able to reconstruct the eigenvalue distribution of these models from their bootstrapped moments. All three methods show excellent agreement for a large matrix size.
summary: 在本文中，我们通过三种方法研究四次型 (0, 1) 和 (1, 0) 狄拉克系综的非对称相位：黎曼-希尔伯特方法、正性引导和哈密顿蒙特卡罗 (HMC) 模拟。这项工作的重点是这些模型的 Schwinger-Dyson 和鞍点方程的非对称解，其解空间非常复杂。通过黎曼-希尔伯特方法，我们能够给出各种解的特征值分布和自由能的明确公式。使用哈密顿蒙特卡罗模拟，我们能够重建相结构。最后，使用正性引导，我们能够根据这些模型的引导矩重建它们的特征值分布。所有三种方法对于大矩阵尺寸都表现出极好的一致性。

title: Heterogeneous Anisotropic Kac Limits on Rectifiable Resolved Cut Spaces
abstract: Ambient convergence does not determine a nonlocal energy on a cut body: a cut has zero volume, but a microscopic bond retains which labelled bank its path crosses. We give a direct measure-theoretic resolution of this information and prove the corresponding sharp-interface Gamma-limit. The cut may be a finite or countable family of Borel, countably rectifiable hypersurfaces with finite total surface mass, measurable approximate normals, and measurable binary bank data. No closedness, positive reach, finite atlas, curvature bound, angle condition, or regularity of the branch set is assumed. For heterogeneous Kac interactions generated by a uniformly spanning family of possibly noncommuting flows, the limit is the resolved anisotropic variation plus the outer boundary contact and one coefficient-one contact on each bank. The Gamma-functional contains no compulsory lower-dimensional term where a crack approaches the boundary; constant recovery creates no concentration there. The proof combines an exact spacetime area formula for flow crossings, a one-dimensional split-extension lower bound, and ordered-flow compactness. We also remove compact radial support. A finite first moment yields the same local Griffith functional; at the power-law threshold the limits separate into local, logarithmically renormalized local, and genuinely fractional regimes. Smooth slit and junction detectors are recovered as uniformly equivalent realizations of the direct crossing rule.
summary:
环境收敛并不能确定切割体上的非局部能量：切割的体积为零，但微观键保留了其路径穿过的标记堤。我们给出了该信息的直接测度理论分辨率，并证明了相应的锐界面伽马极限。切割可以是有限或可数的 Borel 系列、具有有限总表面质量、可测量的近似法线和可测量的二进制组数据的可数可校正超曲面。不假设分支集的封闭性、正范围、有限图集、曲率界限、角度条件或规则性。对于由均匀跨越的可能非交换流族产生的异质 Kac 相互作用，极限是已解析的各向异性变化加上外边界接触和每个岸上的一个系数一接触。当裂纹接近边界时，伽马泛函不包含强制性的低维项；不断的恢复不会在那里产生集中力。该证明结合了流交叉的精确时空面积公式、一维分裂扩展下界和有序流紧致性。我们还移除了紧凑的径向支撑。

有限的一阶矩产生相同的局部格里菲斯泛函；在幂律阈值处，极限分为局部、对数重整局部和真正的分数状态。平滑狭缝和连接检测器被恢复为直接交叉规则的统一等效实现。

title: Tangential Surface Pressures and Boundary Localization in Disordered Edwards--Anderson Models
abstract: We study boundary free energies in disordered Edwards--Anderson Ising models. For rectangular strips of fixed width, we prove that the expected free-to-fixed boundary correction, divided by the tangential length, converges for every finite inverse temperature and at zero temperature. The proof combines a uniform almost-additivity estimate with product-measure concentration, yielding self-averaging along tangential intervals. We derive an exact finite-volume Gaussian interpolation identity and prove that a uniform exponential boundary-mixing condition implies boundary localization with an explicit exponential rate. The tangential pressure theorem extends to all dimensions and symmetric coupling laws with finite first moment; under a product-concentration hypothesis, self-averaging is obtained along tangential cubes. Finally, a subcritical open-bond criterion, verified explicitly for sparse signed couplings, gives low-temperature localization without assuming an infinite-volume Gibbs-state property.
summary: 我们研究无序爱德华-安德森伊辛模型中的边界自由能。对于固定宽度的矩形条，我们证明了预期的自由到固定边界校正除以切向长度，对于每个有限逆温度和零温度收敛。该证明将统一的几乎可加性估计与乘积测量浓度相结合，产生沿切向间隔的自平均。我们推导出精确的有限体积高斯插值恒等式，并证明均匀指数边界混合条件意味着具有显式指数率的边界定位。切向压力定理扩展到所有维度和具有有限初矩的对称耦合定律；在产品浓度假设下，沿着切向立方体获得自平均。最后，亚临界开键准则，针对稀疏符号耦合进行了明确验证，在不假设无限体积吉布斯态特性的情况下给出了低温局域化。

title: An Electrodynamic Lifting of the Toda Monopoles in Curved 3+1 Spacetime
abstract: Every solution of the hyperbolic Toda equation determines a classical Abelian monopole on a (2+1)-dimensional Einstein--Weyl space. We determine when its connection is also a source-free electromagnetic potential on a curved Lorentzian 3+1 spacetime with a spacelike Killing field. On the generic branch, Maxwell's equation classifies the admissible Killing-fibre scale and horizontal twist through one characteristic of the Toda field. A separated Liouville branch gives purely magnetic fields with considerably freer fibre geometry. The round spherical solution yields a monopole of unit charge with conserved flux on a contracting screen. The background metric here is neither assumed to be Einstein nor self-dual.
summary: 双曲 Toda 方程的每个解都确定 (2+1) 维爱因斯坦-韦尔空间上的经典阿贝尔单极子。我们确定它的连接何时也是具有类空间杀伤场的弯曲洛伦兹 3+1 时空上的无源电磁势。在通用分支上，麦克斯韦方程通过 Toda 场的一个特征对可接受的杀伤纤维尺度和水平扭曲进行分类。分离的刘维尔分支提供纯磁场和相当自由的纤维几何形状。圆形球形溶液在收缩屏幕上产生具有守恒通量的单位电荷单极子。这里的背景度量既不假设是爱因斯坦的，也不假设是自对偶的。

title: Factorization method for a clamped obstacle from near-field measurements via a far-field transformation
abstract: This paper considers an inverse shape problem for recovering an unknown impenetrable clamped obstacle in two dimensions from near-field point source and dipole measurements for the biharmonic Helmholtz equation in the frequency domain. The measured data consist of the scattered field and its normal derivative on a closed measurement curve surrounding the obstacle. Since the associated near-field operator does not directly admit the symmetric factorization required by the factorization method, we introduce a far-field transformation. This transformation is defined independently of the obstacle and augments the near-field operator into the associated far-field operator which does admit a symmetric factorization. This yields a rigorous complete characterization of the obstacle by the factorization method theory and leads to a practical reconstruction algorithm based on the spectral data of the transformed operator. Numerical experiments are presented to demonstrate the effectiveness of the proposed method, with synthetic near-field data generated using the method of fundamental solutions. We also consider reconstructions using only scattered-field measurements generated by point sources, demonstrating the potential for reduced the amount of measured data.
summary:
本文考虑了一个逆形状问题，用于从频域中的双调和亥姆霍兹方程的近场点源和偶极子测量中恢复二维未知的不可穿透的夹紧障碍物。测量数据由散射场及其在围绕障碍物的闭合测量曲线上的法向导数组成。由于相关的近场算子不直接接受分解方法所需的对称分解，因此我们引入了远场变换。这种变换的定义与障碍物无关，并将近场算子增强为相关的远场算子，该远场算子确实允许对称分解。这通过因式分解方法理论产生了对障碍物的严格完整表征，并产生了基于变换算子的光谱数据的实用重建算法。数值实验证明了该方法的有效性，并使用基本解的方法生成了合成近场数据。

我们还考虑仅使用点源生成的散射场测量进行重建，这证明了减少测量数据量的潜力。

title: Phase transitions in non-Hermitian spherical integrals
abstract: We study the large-$N$ asymptotics of a constrained spherical integral for non-Hermitian random matrices, in which the norms and mutual scalar product of two vectors are fixed. In the delocalized regime, the asymptotics are governed by the non-Hermitian transforms $\mathcal R_1$ and $\mathcal R_2$. At saddle-point level, the constrained integral exhibits a transition to a localized regime controlled by the largest singular value of a shifted matrix and by the overlap of its associated left and right singular vectors. Motivated by the Hermitian spherical-integral mechanism and by the Coulomb-gas picture, we formulate conjectures for one-eigenvalue large deviations and boundary fluctuations. Throughout, our analysis is carried out in the spirit of mathematical physics.
summary: 我们研究非厄米特随机矩阵的约束球积分的大$N$渐近性，其中两个向量的范数和互标量积是固定的。在离域状态下，渐近由非厄米变换 $\mathcal R_1$ 和 $\mathcal R_2$ 控制。在鞍点级别，约束积分表现出向局部状态的转变，该局部状态由移位矩阵的最大奇异值及其相关左奇异向量和右奇异向量的重叠控制。受厄米球积分机制和库仑气体图的启发，我们提出了单特征值大偏差和边界涨落的猜想。自始至终，我们的分析都是本着数学物理学的精神进行的。

title: Disorder on the hyperbolic square lattice I: Anderson delocalization and absolutely continuous spectrum
abstract: We study the Anderson model on hyperbolic lattices. The graph is the Cartesian product of the Euclidean lattice with the regular hyperbolic square lattice having five squares at each vertex. We prove the existence of absolutely continuous spectrum and the absence of singular spectrum on a deterministic set of positive measure at weak disorder, and for $0<\lambda\le2$ when the single-site density is bounded below on $[-1,1]$. Truncated Cauchy distributions and controlled perturbations give purely absolutely continuous spectrum on intervals.
summary: 我们研究双曲格子上的安德森模型。该图是欧几里得晶格与每个顶点有五个正方形的正双曲方晶格的笛卡尔积。我们证明了在弱无序的一组确定性正测度上绝对连续谱的存在和奇异谱的不存在，并且对于 $0<\lambda\le2$，当单点密度低于 $[-1,1]$ 时。截断柯西分布和受控扰动给出了间隔上的纯粹绝对连续谱。

title: Qupertino: Pure MLX Array Kernels versus Hand-Tuned Metal Shaders for Quantum Circuit Simulation on Apple Silicon
abstract: We present Qupertino, an open-source quantum circuit simulator for Apple Silicon, and use it to ask how far a simulator written purely in MLX array operations can go and what remains for hand-tuned Metal shaders. The framework ships two measured tiers. The pure tier dispatches structured gates to specialized MLX kernels: diagonal gates run as broadcast phase multiplies, controlled gates as masked half-state updates, and SWAP as an axis permutation; a paired dense-path ablation attributes a 25-33x speedup to this dispatch alone. The opt-in shader tier adds hand-written Metal kernels for every structured layer family in our benchmarks, including phase-LUT diagonals, GF(2) affine permutation gathers, fused tensor-product single-qubit layers, radix-4 QFT and Walsh-Hadamard butterflies, and basis-conjugated XX/YY Trotter layers; runtime fusion detectors route work to them while preserving circuit semantics exactly, confirmed by parity tests. In a four-way interleaved campaign on M1 Max (two warmups, ten measured repeats per cell), the shader tier is fastest by mean runtime in all 18 comparison cells against same-machine Qiskit Aer CPU and PennyLane this http URL . At 25 qubits, gate-stream QFT runs in 0.0591 +/- 0.0029 s (paired 47.2x over Aer, 95.3x over PennyLane) and TFIM Trotter evolution in 0.495 +/- 0.035 s (36.2x and 67.2x). Across a 29-workload suite, the shader tier's paired speedup over pure MLX reaches 25x, with 25 of 29 workloads accelerating above parity. The framework also supports variational ansatz workloads, QAOA, QCBM, Trotter-Suzuki Hamiltonian simulation, and OpenQASM 2.0 import (unitary subset); a preliminary MPS backend reaches 150 qubits on limited-entanglement workloads. Correctness rests on 253 Python tests, independent complex128 checks, and a Trotter-error curve against exact diagonalization. State-vector memory remains exponential in qubit count.
summary:
我们展示了 Qupertino，一个针对 Apple Silicon 的开源量子电路模拟器，并用它来询问纯粹用 MLX 阵列操作编写的模拟器可以走多远，以及手动调整的 Metal 着色器还剩下什么。该框架提供两个测量层。纯层将结构化门分派给专门的 MLX 内核：对角线门作为广播相位乘法运行，受控门作为屏蔽半状态更新运行，SWAP 作为轴排列运行；仅此一次调度，配对密集路径消融就可以实现 25-33 倍的加速。选择加入的着色器层为我们的基准测试中的每个结构化层系列添加了手写的 Metal 内核，包括相位 LUT 对角线、GF(2) 仿射排列集合、融合张量积单量子位层、radix-4 QFT 和 Walsh-Hadamard 蝴蝶以及基础共轭 XX/YY Trotter 层；运行时融合检测器将工作路由给它们，同时准确地保留电路语义，并通过奇偶校验测试确认。在 M1 Max 上的四向交错活动中（两次热身，每个单元 10 次测量重复），在所有 18 个比较单元中，着色器层相对于同一机器 Qiskit Aer CPU 和 PennyLane 此 http URL 的平均运行时间最快。

在 25 个量子位下，门流 QFT 的运行时间为 0.0591 +/- 0.0029 秒（与 Aer 配对 47.2 倍，与 PennyLane 配对 95.3 倍），而 TFIM Trotter 演化则在 0.495 +/- 0.035 秒内运行（36.2 倍和 67.2 倍）。在包含 29 个工作负载的套件中，着色器层相对于纯 MLX 的成对加速达到 25 倍，其中 29 个工作负载中有 25 个的加速速度超过了同等水平。该框架还支持变分 ansatz 工作负载、QAOA、QCBM、Trotter-Suzuki Hamiltonian 模拟和 OpenQASM 2.0 导入（酉子集）；初步的 MPS 后端在有限纠缠工作负载上达到 150 个量子位。正确性依赖于 253 个 Python 测试、独立的复杂 128 个检查以及针对精确对角化的 Trotter 误差曲线。状态向量内存在量子位计数方面保持指数增长。

title: Energy-Constrained Commutator Variance for Weyl Pairs
abstract: Let $W$ be a representation of the Weyl relations on a separable Hilbert space and write $\mathcal R_W(K)=\{W(f):f\in K\}''$. If the symplectic pairing of $K_1$ and $K_2$ is nonzero, there is a self-adjoint unitary $B\in\mathcal R_W(K_2)$ such that, for every normal state $\rho$, one can choose a self-adjoint unitary $A_\rho\in\mathcal R_W(K_1)$ with $\operatorname{Var}_\rho(-i[A_\rho,B])=4$. Hence the optimized mean-input-energy-constrained coefficient equals $4$ at every admissible energy threshold. For the fixed trigonometric Weyl witness $h$, an exact identity for $4-h^2$ reduces the deficit to a phase-fixed problem for commuting squared Weyl translations. For the one-mode quadratic energy $G_M=\frac12 R^TMR-\frac12\sqrt{\det M}$, with $M>0$ and $u^T\Omega v=\pi$, we prove $4-\gamma_{G_M,E}(h)=\frac{u^TMu+v^TMv+2\pi\sqrt{\det M}}{4E}+O(E^{-2})$. The lower bound holds over all normal states satisfying the mean-energy constraint, and a localized Zak construction attains the same coefficient. For $G=d\Gamma(H_1)$ and witness directions $u,v\in\operatorname{dom}H_1^{1/2}$, the fixed-witness deficit is $\Theta(E^{-1})$ whenever at least one direction lies outside $\ker H_1$; if both directions are zero modes, the constrained supremum equals the endpoint at every positive threshold.
summary:
令 $W$ 为可分离希尔伯特空间上的 Weyl 关系的表示，并写作 $\mathcal R_W(K)=\{W(f):f\in K\}''$。如果 $K_1$ 和 $K_2$ 的辛配对非零，则存在一个自伴酉 $B\in\mathcal R_W(K_2)$，这样，对于每个正常状态 $\rho$，可以选择一个自伴酉 $A_\rho\in\mathcal R_W(K_1)$ $\operatorname{Var}_\rho(-i[A_\rho,B])=4$.因此，在每个允许的能量阈值下，优化的平均输入能量约束系数等于 4 美元。对于固定三角 Weyl 见证 $h$，$4-h^2$ 的精确恒等式将赤字减少为通勤平方 Weyl 平移的相位固定问题。对于一模二次能量 $G_M=\frac12 R^TMR-\frac12\sqrt{\det M}$，$M>0$ 且 $u^T\Omega v=\pi$，我们证明 $4-\gamma_{G_M,E}(h)=\frac{u^TMu+v^TMv+2\pi\sqrt{\det M}}{4E}+O(E^{-2})$。下界适用于满足平均能量约束的所有正常状态，并且局部 Zak 结构获得相同的系数。

对于 $G=d\Gamma(H_1)$ 和见证方向 $u,v\in\operatorname{dom}H_1^{1/2}$，只要至少一个方向位于 $\ker H_1$ 之外，固定见证赤字就是 $\Theta(E^{-1})$；如果两个方向都是零模式，则约束上界等于每个正阈值处的端点。

title: Enhanced Emission and Two-Photon Interference of Lead-Vacancy Centers in Diamond Solid Immersion Lenses
abstract: A negatively charged lead-vacancy (PbV-) center in diamond is a novel quantum system which can be operated at a high temperature above 4 K owing to its large ground state splitting. To unlock the quantum properties of the PbV- center, the enhancement of the fluorescence intensity is a key issue. Here, we demonstrate enhanced emission from PbV- centers by a factor of approximately 10 using solid immersion lenses (SILs) fabricated on rough diamond surface caused by high-temperature anneal over 2000°C. Resonant excitation reveals the narrow emission close to the transform-limited linewidth. Furthermore, we demonstrate two-photon interference using one single PbV- center in an SIL. This enhanced emission and indistinguishability will lead to further development of the PbV- center towards quantum network node applications.
summary: 金刚石中带负电的铅空位（PbV-）中心是一种新颖的量子系统，由于其大的基态分裂，可以在 4 K 以上的高温下运行。为了解锁PbV-中心的量子特性，荧光强度的增强是一个关键问题。在这里，我们证明了使用在粗糙金刚石表面上制造的固体浸没透镜 (SIL)，由超过 2000°C 的高温退火引起的 PbV 中心发射增强了约 10 倍。谐振激发揭示了接近变换限制线宽的窄发射。此外，我们在 SIL 中使用单个 PbV 中心演示了双光子干涉。这种增强的发射和不可区分性将导致 PbV 中心向量子网络节点应用的进一步发展。

title: Lazy training of quantum physics informed neural networks
abstract: We study the gradient-flow training dynamics of quantum physics-informed neural networks (QPINNs) for the solution of second-order elliptic partial differential equations with Dirichlet boundary conditions. We consider parameterized quantum circuits as function approximators and analyze their overparameterized regime through the lens of the neural tangent kernel (NTK). Our contribution is a nonasymptotic lazy-training theory for QPINNs and their variational formulation: we prove that, for sufficiently large circuit width, the nonlinear gradient flow is quantitatively approximated by a linearized NTK model, with explicit bounds depending on the number of qubits, circuit depth, circuit light-cone geometry, and the dimension of the domain of the solution to the PDE.
summary: 我们研究量子物理神经网络（QPINN）的梯度流训练动力学，用于求解具有狄利克雷边界条件的二阶椭圆偏微分方程。我们将参数化量子电路视为函数逼近器，并通过神经正切核 (NTK) 的视角分析其超参数化状态。我们的贡献是 QPINN 及其变分公式的非渐近惰性训练理论：我们证明，对于足够大的电路宽度，非线性梯度流可以通过线性化 NTK 模型定量近似，其显式边界取决于量子位的数量、电路深度、电路光锥几何形状以及 PDE 解的域维度。

title: Achieving the limits of automorphism gates
abstract: Universal fault-tolerant quantum computing combines versatile but expensive operations with specialized but cheap ones. Its efficiency depends on how much computation can be pushed onto the cheap operations and on the size of the code needed to do so. Automorphism gates provide such cheap operations using only physical single-qubit Clifford gates and qubit permutations. Yet no general theory characterizes their maximum logical power or the minimum code size needed to attain it. We develop such a theory. For stabilizer codes encoding $k\geq3$ logical qubits, we show that the largest logical group attainable by automorphisms is generated by all addressable $S$ and $\mathrm{CX}$ gates, and we construct codes attaining it. While this group contains exponentially fewer gates than the full Clifford group, adding one suitable non-Clifford gate yields universality. We further classify the largest logical groups attainable using qubit permutations, physical single-qubit Cliffords, or both across general stabilizer and CSS codes, and derive refined bounds for self-dual CSS subclasses. Achieving the maximum-size logical group through automorphisms requires $n=\Theta(2^k)$ physical qubits. By contrast, all addressable diagonal Clifford gates, generated by $S$ and $\mathrm{CZ}$, require only $n=\Theta(k^2)$ physical qubits when implemented using physical single-qubit Cliffords alone. Both bounds are tight. This polynomial qubit cost extends beyond Cliffords to all addressable diagonal gates at any fixed level of the Clifford hierarchy, using physical single-qubit diagonal gates. Thus, for full addressability, the sharpest physical-qubit cost divide lies between diagonal and $\mathrm{CX}$-type gates, not between Clifford and non-Clifford gates.
summary:
通用容错量子计算将通用但昂贵的操作与专用但廉价的操作结合起来。它的效率取决于可以将多少计算推送到廉价操作上以及执行此操作所需的代码大小。自同构门仅使用物理单量子位克利福德门和量子位排列来提供如此廉价的操作。然而，没有一般理论来描述它们的最大逻辑能力或实现它所需的最小代码大小。我们发展了这样一个理论。对于编码 $k\geq3$ 逻辑量子位的稳定器代码，我们表明自同构可实现的最大逻辑群是由所有可寻址 $S$ 和 $\mathrm{CX}$ 门生成的，并且我们构造了实现它的代码。虽然该组包含的门比整个 Clifford 组少得多，但添加一个合适的非 Clifford 门会产生通用性。我们进一步对使用量子位排列、物理单量子位 Cliffords 或两者在通用稳定器和 CSS 代码中可获得的最大逻辑组进行分类，并导出自对偶 CSS 子类的细化界限。通过自同构实现最大尺寸逻辑群需要 $n=\Theta(2^k)$ 个物理量子位。

相比之下，由 $S$ 和 $\mathrm{CZ}$ 生成的所有可寻址对角 Clifford 门，在单独使用物理单量子位 Cliffords 实现时，仅需要 $n=\Theta(k^2)$ 物理量子位。两个界限都很紧。使用物理单量子位对角门，该多项式量子位成本扩展到 Cliffords 之外的任何固定级别的 Clifford 层次结构中的所有可寻址对角门。因此，对于完全可寻址性，最明显的物理量子位成本划分位于对角线门和 $\mathrm{CX}$ 型门之间，而不是 Clifford 门和非 Clifford 门之间。

title: Emergent classicality and wavefunction branching in an isolated quantum many-body system
abstract: Decoherence in quantum systems is conventionally modeled as the effect of interactions with an external environment. However, such a prescription excludes isolated many-body systems, which are also expected to display classical behavior at macroscopic scales. In isolated systems, decoherence must emerge internally from microscopic degrees of freedom that are invisible to the macroscopic description. Here we explicitly show that classicality can emerge in such a fashion. We consider a weakly disordered, $3$-local chaotic kicked top of $N$ qubits, where the collective spin sector serves as the macroscopic description, while the microscopic permutation sector acts as an internal bath, decohering the collective spin sector. Starting from closed unitary dynamics, we derive and numerically confirm an effective Lindblad equation for the collective spin variables. In the thermodynamic limit these reduced dynamics converge to a classical chaotic Fokker--Planck equation with vanishingly small diffusion on the spherical phase space, producing a quantum-classical correspondence beyond the Ehrenfest time. The chaotic dynamics evolve the pure many-body wavefunction into continuously branching components associated with distinct classical trajectories. These branches acquire nearly orthogonal microscopic records in the permutation sector, preventing quantum interferences and ensuring the corresponding histories remain consistent.
summary:
