量子系统中的退相干通常被建模为与外部环境相互作用的影响。然而，这样的处方排除了孤立的多体系统，这些系统也有望在宏观尺度上表现出经典行为。在孤立系统中，退相干必须从宏观描述中不可见的微观自由度内部出现。在这里，我们明确地表明古典性可以以这种方式出现。我们考虑一个弱无序的、$3$局部混沌踢到$N$量子位的顶部，其中集体自旋扇区作为宏观描述，而微观排列扇区充当内部浴，使集体自旋扇区脱相干。从闭酉动力学出发，我们推导并数值证实了集体自旋变量的有效 Lindblad 方程。在热力学极限下，这些简化的动力学收敛到经典的混沌福克-普朗克方程，在球形相空间上扩散极小，产生超出埃伦菲斯特时间的量子经典对应关系。

混沌动力学将纯多体波函数演化为与不同经典轨迹相关的连续分支分量。这些分支在排列扇区中获得近乎正交的微观记录，防止量子干扰并确保相应的历史保持一致。

title: Fifty Years of the GKLS Master Equation: Foundations and Early Developments
abstract: The year 2026 marks the fiftieth anniversary of the two seminal papers in which Gorini, Kossakowski, and Sudarshan, and independently Lindblad, characterized the generators of completely positive quantum dynamical semigroups. We revisit the conceptual and historical route leading to the Gorini-Kossakowski-Lindblad-Sudarshan (GKLS) master equation and examine several of its early developments and consequences. Our aim is to show how several initially separate mathematical and physical ideas converged in the GKLS structure theorem, imme- diately opening the way to manifold consequences for the description of dissipative quantum phenomena and how that theorem, fifty years later, remains both a foundational result and an active framework for open quantum dynamics.
summary: 2026 年是戈里尼、科萨科夫斯基和苏达山以及林德布拉德独立描述完全正量子动力学半群生成元的两篇开创性论文发表 50 周年。我们重新审视导致 Gorini-Kossakowski-Lindblad-Sudarshan (GKLS) 主方程的概念和历史路线，并研究其早期发展和后果。我们的目的是展示几个最初独立的数学和物理思想如何在 GKLS 结构定理中聚合，立即为描述耗散量子现象的多种后果开辟道路，以及该定理如何在 50 年后仍然是开放量子动力学的基础结果和活跃框架。

title: Symmetry-driven correlation patterns in one-dimensional periodic fermionic systems: closed-form expressions and exact selection rules for correlation functions, entanglement entropies and mutual information
abstract: We present an analytical study of the spatial structure of correlations in periodic fermionic systems at the single Slater determinant level, focusing on the cyclic case. Exploiting cyclic symmetry, the transformation from localized orbitals to molecular orbitals is simultaneously a discrete Fourier transform, a Vandermonde matrix on the roots of unity, a complex Hadamard matrix, and the character table of the cyclic group $C_m$. Within this framework, the spatial structure of correlations is fully determined by the occupied irreducible representations (Fourier modes), independently of the specific Hamiltonian generating them. In particular, the fermionic two-point correlator is expressed as a truncated Fourier sum over the occupied orbitals, leading to exact analytical expressions for symmetric occupation patterns of Fourier modes ($\ell$ and $-\ell$ pairs), corresponding in quantum chemistry to aromatic fillings, i.e. fillings satisfying Hückel's $4n + 2$ rule. For the half filling case, we derive exact spatial selection rules. In particular, the two-point correlator vanishes identically for all even distances along the ring. This property propagates to reduced density matrices and implies a complete absence of mutual information between the corresponding orbitals. These results reveal that, despite the global delocalization of molecular orbitals, the correlation structure in cyclic systems is highly non-uniform and governed by symmetry-induced interference. Although formulated in terms of cyclic lattice systems, the present results extend straightforwardly to one-dimensional fermionic chains with periodic conditions, reflecting the underlying translational symmetry of the problem. The framework therefore provides a Hamiltonian-independent and universal reference for understanding correlation patterns in one-dimensional periodic fermionic systems.
summary:
我们对单斯莱特行列式水平上的周期性费米子系统中相关性的空间结构进行了分析研究，重点关注循环情况。利用循环对称性，从定域轨道到分子轨道的变换同时是离散傅立叶变换、单位根上的范德蒙矩阵、复阿达玛矩阵以及循环群$C_m$的特征表。在这个框架内，相关性的空间结构完全由占据的不可约表示（傅里叶模式）决定，独立于生成它们的特定哈密顿量。特别是，费米子两点相关器被表示为占据轨道上的截断傅里叶和，从而得到傅里叶模式对称占据模式（$\ell$和$-\ell$对）的精确解析表达式，对应于量子化学中的芳香填充，即满足休克尔$4n + 2$规则的填充。对于半填充的情况，我们推导出精确的空间选择规则。特别是，对于沿环的所有偶数距离，两点相关器都相同地消失。

该属性传播到约化密度矩阵，并且意味着相应轨道之间完全不存在互信息。这些结果表明，尽管分子轨道存在全局离域，但循环系统中的相关结构是高度不均匀的，并且受到对称性引起的干扰的控制。尽管是根据循环晶格系统制定的，但目前的结果直接扩展到具有周期性条件的一维费米子链，反映了问题的潜在平移对称性。因此，该框架为理解一维周期性费米子系统中的相关模式提供了独立于哈密顿量的通用参考。

title: A Bi-Objective Routing Framework for Hybrid Terrestrial-Satellite Quantum Networks
abstract: Hybrid terrestrial-satellite quantum networks combine terrestrial fiber infrastructure with free-space links to enable long-distance entanglement distribution. Entanglement can be routed over different combinations of terrestrial and satellite links, resulting in paths with different entanglement generation rates (EGRs) and fidelities. Existing routing algorithms, however, typically reduce routing to a single-objective problem by optimizing either EGR or fidelity, or by optimizing one while constraining the other, and thus do not explicitly capture the trade-off between the two. In this paper, we present a bi-objective routing framework for hybrid quantum networks that jointly optimizes end-to-end EGR and fidelity. We formulate routing as a Pareto optimization problem and show that it possesses a special mathematical structure: the bottleneck nature of end-to-end EGR and the multiplicative nature of end-to-end fidelity allow the problem to be transformed into a MAXMIN-MINSUM bi-criterion path problem. This transformation enables the exact polynomial-time computation of a minimal complete Pareto set using Martins' bicriterion routing algorithm. Our results demonstrate that hybrid networks expose substantially richer Pareto frontiers than terrestrial-only networks and that the proposed framework outperforms representative single-objective routing policies by allowing applications to select paths based on their EGR and fidelity requirements.
summary:
混合地面卫星量子网络将地面光纤基础设施与自由空间链路相结合，以实现长距离纠缠分布。纠缠可以通过地面和卫星链路的不同组合进行路由，从而产生具有不同纠缠发生率 (EGR) 和保真度的路径。然而，现有的路由算法通常通过优化 EGR 或保真度，或者通过在约束另一个的同时优化其中之一来减少单目标问题的路由，因此没有明确地捕获两者之间的权衡。在本文中，我们提出了一种用于混合量子网络的双目标路由框架，该框架联合优化端到端 EGR 和保真度。我们将路径规划为帕累托优化问题，并表明它具有特殊的数学结构：端到端EGR的瓶颈性质和端到端保真度的乘法性质允许问题转化为MAXMIN-MINSUM双准则路径问题。这种变换使得能够使用 Martins 的双准则路由算法对最小完整 Pareto 集进行精确的多项式时间计算。

我们的结果表明，混合网络比纯地面网络暴露出更丰富的帕累托前沿，并且所提出的框架通过允许应用程序根据其 EGR 和保真度要求选择路径，从​​而优于代表性的单目标路由策略。

title: Dephasing-Enhanced Response and Phase Transitions in Quantum Boltzmann Samplers
abstract: Dephasing can drive a quantum Boltzmann sampler into an ordered phase while its programmed probability distribution remains disordered. We trace this transition to an enhanced conditional response: coherence loss changes how each spin responds to its neighbors, and interactions amplify the change. For all-to-all coupling, we establish the stationary transition at finite dephasing. Near criticality, the magnetization distribution depends on the ratio of dephasing strength to the square root of system size, retaining a finite imprint of coherence even as the local coherent correction vanishes. In the strong-dephasing limit on a square lattice, the dynamics generates effective multispin interactions and probability currents, with Ising-like critical statistics. Adjusting the local dissipative update restores the target probability process on arbitrary graphs.
summary: 移相可以将量子玻尔兹曼采样器驱动到有序相位，而其编程的概率分布仍然是无序的。我们将这种转变追溯到增强的条件响应：相干性损失改变了每个自旋对其邻居的响应方式，并且相互作用放大了这种变化。对于全对全耦合，我们在有限相移处建立稳态过渡。在接近临界点时，磁化强度分布取决于移相强度与系统尺寸平方根的比率，即使局部相干校正消失，仍保留有限的相干印记。在方晶格的强相移极限下，动力学产生有效的多自旋相互作用和概率电流，并具有类似伊辛的临界统计量。调整局部耗散更新可以恢复任意图上的目标概率过程。

title: Quantum computers will not be that different: A blueprint for quantum computer architecture at scale
abstract: Quantum computers are technologically novel and unusual, but at system scale they should be engineered using many of the same principles that govern classical heterogeneous accelerators. This paper argues that utility-scale quantum architecture is primarily a cost-performance problem across a coupled quantum-classical system, leading to a blueprint for scalable quantum processing unit (QPU) design. Our architecture blueprint is organized around clean logical abstractions, hiding details and complexity of physical qubit modalities below the instruction set architecture (ISA) boundary, and specializes recurring functions aggressively to minimize the cost for utility scale quantum computations. Its low-level implementation through specialized local hardware for control, readout, and quantum error correction (QEC) closely resembles the architecture of high-performance network stacks. One of our main insights is that the design principles and the resulting architecture closely follow established practice from classical computing and networking.
summary: 量子计算机在技术上是新颖且不寻常的，但在系统规模上，它们应该使用许多与经典异构加速器相同的原理来设计。本文认为，公用事业规模的量子架构主要是耦合量子经典系统中的成本性能问题，从而形成了可扩展量子处理单元（QPU）设计的蓝图。我们的架构蓝图围绕干净的逻辑抽象进行组织，隐藏指令集架构 (ISA) 边界以下物理量子位模态的细节和复杂性，并积极专门化重复函数，以最大限度地降低公用事业规模量子计算的成本。其通过专门的本地硬件进行控制、读出和量子纠错（QEC）的低级实现与高性能网络堆栈的架构非常相似。我们的主要见解之一是设计原则和最终的架构紧密遵循经典计算和网络的既定实践。

title: Improving Sample Efficiency in Peptide-HLA Binding Prediction with Hybrid Quantum-Classical Neural Networks
abstract: Peptide-HLA binding prediction is a critical step in neoantigen identification for personalized cancer immunotherapy and holds significant clinical value. However, the training data available for many HLA alleles are extremely limited, which severely constrains the performance of conventional methods on this task. Parameterized quantum circuits are hypothesized to induce inductive biases beneficial for learning from small datasets, yet their application to biological sequence prediction remains underexplored. To address this, we propose a hybrid quantum-classical neural network (HQNN) specifically designed for peptide-HLA binding prediction. HQNN integrates multi-source biological feature encoding with parallel quantum feature extractors and a quantum-enhanced classifier. On two HLA alleles (A*02:01 and B*07:02), HQNN outperforms a parameter-matched classical CNN baseline across all training sizes, with the performance gap widening as training data decreases. Ablation studies confirm the respective contributions of the quantum feature extraction module and the quantum classifier. In noise-aware simulations, performance degrades only mildly, and such degradation is reasonable and acceptable under realistic quantum hardware noise levels. These results suggest that hybrid quantum-classical architectures can provide practical sample-efficiency gains for immunoinformatics tasks in low-data regimes.
summary:
肽-HLA结合预测是个性化癌症免疫治疗新抗原鉴定的关键步骤，具有重要的临床价值。然而，许多 HLA 等位基因的可用训练数据极其有限，这严重限制了传统方法在此任务上的性能。参数化量子电路被假设会引起有利于从小数据集学习的归纳偏差，但它们在生物序列预测中的应用仍未得到充分探索。为了解决这个问题，我们提出了一种专为肽-HLA 结合预测而设计的混合量子经典神经网络 (HQNN)。 HQNN 将多源生物特征编码与并行量子特征提取器和量子增强分类器集成在一起。在两个 HLA 等位基因（A*02:01 和 B*07:02）上，HQNN 在所有训练规模上都优于参数匹配的经典 CNN 基线，并且随着训练数据的减少，性能差距扩大。消融研究证实了量子特征提取模块和量子分类器各自的贡献。

在噪声感知模拟中，性能仅轻微下降，并且在实际量子硬件噪声水平下，这种下降是合理且可接受的。这些结果表明，混合量子经典架构可以为低数据状态下的免疫信息学任务提供实用的样本效率增益。

title: Linear combination of Schrödingerization for quantum linear systems with optimal matrix-query complexity
abstract: Quantum linear systems algorithms (QLSAs) aim to solve linear systems $A\bb{x}=\bb{b}$ exponentially faster than classical methods under certain conditions. In this work, we develop quantum algorithms for solving linear algebraic equations from an ODE-based perspective. Inspired by the linear combination of Hamiltonian simulation (LCHS) representation in the Fourier approach \cite{Childs2017QLSA}, we express the solution $\bb{x}$ as a linear combination of solutions to a system of linear convection equations, which become Schrödinger-type equations with unitary evolutions in the Fourier domain. We refer to this representation as LC-Schrödingerization. Based on this result, we construct an LCHS-based quantum algorithm with two LCHS instances: one for time-marching and one for numerical integration. The key construction uses the derivative of a Gaussian-smoothed hat function and recovers the solution over a fixed auxiliary interval. This permits a truncation time independent of the target accuracy and avoids the loss in success probability from selecting a single grid point. Periodization and explicit Fourier coefficients provide the corresponding projection error bounds. Under the stated oracle assumptions and given a constant-factor estimate of the solution norm, direct simulation of the select operators and block preconditioning achieve the optimal matrix-query complexity $\mathcal{O}(\kappa_A\log\frac1\varepsilon)$ without using variable-time amplitude amplification (VTAA). The same upper bound holds for queries to the right-hand-side preparation oracle.
summary:
量子线性系统算法 (QLSA) 的目标是在某些条件下以指数速度比经典方法更快地求解线性系统 $A\bb{x}=\bb{b}$。在这项工作中，我们开发了从基于 ODE 的角度求解线性代数方程的量子算法。受傅里叶方法中哈密顿模拟（LCHS）表示的线性组合的启发，我们将解 $\bb{x}$ 表示为线性对流方程组解的线性组合，该方程组成为在傅里叶域中具有酉演化的薛定谔型方程。我们将这种表示称为 LC-薛定谔化。基于这一结果，我们构建了一种基于 LCHS 的量子算法，具有两个 LCHS 实例：一个用于时间推进，一个用于数值积分。关键构造使用高斯平滑帽子函数的导数，并在固定的辅助区间上恢复解。这允许截断时间与目标精度无关，并避免因选择单个网格点而导致成功概率的损失。周期化和显式傅里叶系数提供了相应的投影误差范围。

在规定的预言机假设下，并给定解范数的常数因子估计，选择运算符和块预处理的直接模拟可实现最佳矩阵查询复杂度 $\mathcal{O}(\kappa_A\log\frac1\varepsilon)$，而不使用可变时间幅度放大 (VTAA)。对于右侧准备预言机的查询也适用相同的上限。

title: Exact Local Optimality Does Not Compose: The Complexity of Chronological Realization
abstract: The chronological shared realization complexity (CRC) is the smallest normalized stochastic state dimension $C_{\rm seq}$ needed to reproduce a collection of future-response menus using one shared family of controlled transition dynamics. We focus on the rank-tight regime in which both the local realization dimension and the independent-query static carrier width equal $K$, thereby isolating the additional dimensional and computational constraints imposed by chronological consistency. This framework also serves as the classical baseline for state-dimension bounds in sequential quantum processes, where stochastic dynamics generalize to completely positive maps. We establish three results in this regime. First, an explicit payload--delay family exhibits an unbounded multiplicative state blow-up: $C_{\rm loc}=C_{\rm stat}=k$ while $C_{\rm seq}=k(L+1)$, isolating the intrinsic state cost of shared temporal pullbacks. Second, for explicitly listed rational finite menus over a fixed five-letter alphabet with a single Boolean terminal effect, exact shared realizability is $\exists\mathbb{R}$-complete, and the zero-versus-inverse-polynomial defect promise problem is $\mathsf{PromiseNP}$-complete, with local and static optima fixed at $K$. Third, a total five-letter chronology compiler translates bounded-rational Intermediate Simplex instances into a polynomially specified regular geometric family over the same fixed alphabet, preserving exact local and static width $K$. The compiled family yields strong $\mathsf{PromiseNP}$-hardness for shared realization on strongly bounded-rational inputs, together with an $\exists\mathbb{R}$ upper bound certified by an exact polynomial-size finite core. Together, these results show that exact local and static optimality need not compose under chronological sharing, even in the rank-tight regime.
summary:
按时间顺序共享实现复杂度 (CRC) 是使用受控过渡动态的共享族来重现未来响应菜单集合所需的最小归一化随机状态维度 $C_{\rm seq}$。我们关注等级紧的机制，其中局部实现维度和独立查询静态载体宽度都等于 $K$，从而隔离了时间一致性所施加的额外维度和计算约束。该框架还充当顺序量子过程中状态维边界的经典基线，其中随机动力学可推广到完全正映射。我们在这个制度中建立了三个结果。首先，显式有效负载延迟族表现出无界乘法状态爆炸：$C_{\rm loc}=C_{\rm stat}=k$ 而 $C_{\rm seq}=k(L+1)$，隔离共享时间回调的内在状态成本。

其次，对于具有单个布尔终端效应的固定五字母字母表上明确列出的有理有限菜单，精确的共享可实现性是 $\exists\mathbb{R}$ 完全的，零与逆多项式缺陷承诺问题是 $\mathsf{PromiseNP}$ 完全的，局部和静态最优值固定为 $K$。第三，总共五个字母的时间顺序编译器将有界有理中间单纯形实例转换为同一固定字母表上多项式指定的规则几何族，保留精确的局部和静态宽度$K$。编译后的系列为强有界有理输入的共享实现提供了强大的 $\mathsf{PromiseNP}$ 硬度，以及由精确多项式大小的有限核心认证的 $\exists\mathbb{R}$ 上限。总之，这些结果表明，即使在等级紧张的情况下，精确的局部和静态最优性也不需要在时间共享下组成。

title: 90%-Efficient Optical Storage in a Rare-Earth Crystal with a Low-Loss Impedance-Matched Cavity
abstract: High-efficiency optical storage in rare-earth-ion-doped crystals is challenging because of their typically weak optical absorption,which makes cavity-enhanced memories highly sensitive to parasitic intracavity loss. Here we demonstrate a 90.1(5)% storage efficiency for coherent optical pulses in an impedance-matched cavity atomic-frequency-comb memory based on Eu3+:Y2SiO5. The Brewster-angle configuration of the crystal and fully cryogenic Fabry-Pérot cavity reduce the round-trip intracavity loss to 0.37%. Quantitative modeling shows that further improvement is limited primarily by AFC preparation and its associated dispersive response rather than by residual cavity loss,identifying the principal requirements for further approaching unity efficiency.
summary: 稀土离子掺杂晶体的高效光存储具有挑战性，因为它们的光吸收通常较弱，这使得腔增强存储器对腔内寄生损耗高度敏感。在这里，我们展示了基于 Eu3+:Y2SiO5 的阻抗匹配腔原子频率梳存储器中相干光脉冲的存储效率为 90.1(5)%。晶体的布鲁斯特角结构和全低温法布里-珀罗腔将腔内往返损耗降低至 0.37%。定量模型表明，进一步的改进主要受到 AFC 制备及其相关色散响应的限制，而不是残余腔体损耗的限制，从而确定了进一步接近统一效率的主要要求。

title: Automated search for highly contextual Kochen-Specker proofs
abstract: Observable-based Kochen-Specker proofs are configurations of multi-qubit Pauli observables grouped into contexts whose products are plus or minus the indentity. Their robustness as state-independent contextuality tests can be measured by the tolerated error per context $\varepsilon = 2d/|H|$, where $d$ is the contextuality degree and $|H|$ the number of contexts. Since the degree depends only on an underlying abstract structure called the hypergram i.e. the pair formed by the context hypergraph and the anticommutation graph, the search for highly contextual proofs can be carried out on them instead, with no reference to qubits or to any particular Pauli labeling. We further exploit this by enumerating anticommutation graphs first, and then by associating to each graph $G$ the single hypergram carrying its entire hypergraph support $HS(G)$, so that exactly one candidate is examined per graph. Applied to the House of Graphs database and to censuses of vertex-transitive graphs on at most 24 vertices, this pipeline recovers the Peres-Mermin square, the doily and the Mermin pentagram, and yields configurations reaching $\varepsilon = 0.707$, against $0.424$ for the previous published record. The best configurations are predominantly those stemming from line graphs and unions of graphs; we explain the former by showing that every perfect matching of a graph is a context of its line graph, which exhibits the Peres-Mermin square and the doily as the first members of two infinite families. We close with finite geometric descriptions of the most striking configurations inside symplectic polar spaces, in terms of ovoids, hyperbolic quadrics and Fano planes.
summary:
基于可观察量的 Kochen-Specker 证明是多量子位泡利可观察量的配置，这些可观察量被分组到其乘积加上或减去同一性的上下文中。它们作为与状态无关的上下文测试的鲁棒性可以通过每个上下文的容忍误差 $\varepsilon = 2d/|H|$ 来衡量，其中 $d$ 是上下文程度，$|H|$ 是上下文数量。由于程度仅取决于称为超图的底层抽象结构，即由上下文超图和反交换图形成的对，因此可以对它们进行高度上下文证明的搜索，而不参考量子位或任何特定的泡利标签。我们进一步利用这一点，首先枚举反交换图，然后将每个图 $G$ 与携带整个超图支持 $HS(G)$ 的单个超图关联起来，以便每个图只检查一个候选者。

应用于 House of Graphs 数据库以及最多 24 个顶点的顶点传递图的普查，该管道恢复了 Peres-Mermin 正方形、桌布和 Mermin 五角星，并产生达到 $\varepsilon = 0.707$ 的配置，而之前发布的记录为 $0.424$。最好的配置主要是来自折线图和图并集的配置；我们通过证明图形的每一个完美匹配都是其线图的上下文来解释前者，该线图将 Peres-Mermin 正方形和花边展示为两个无限家族的第一个成员。我们以卵形、双曲二次曲面和法诺平面等对辛极空间内最引人注目的构型进行有限几何描述作为结束。

title: Quantum Graph Convolutional Networks: Implementation and Trainability Analysis
abstract: Graph Neural Networks (GNNs) achieve state-of-the-art performance on graph-structured data, but training and inference on large graphs are often bottlenecked by memory constraints and sparse linear-algebra workloads. Quantum computing offers an alternative set of primitives that may improve scalability for graph learning. Building on the quantum graph neural network (QGNN) framework of Liao \textit{et al.}, this work implements two representative architectures --- the Simplified Graph Convolution (SGC) and Linear Graph Convolution (LGC) models --- and evaluates them on open benchmark graph datasets and semi-supervised learning tasks using quantum simulation. We compare predictive performance and optimization behavior against classical baselines, showing that the quantum models achieve competitive performance with fewer parameters. Finally, we present a cost gradient analysis that identifies the tasks for which the models showcased are trainable. This is followed by a classical simulability study to find regimes in which the proposed circuits remain robust during training.
summary: 图神经网络 (GNN) 在图结构数据上实现了最先进的性能，但大型图的训练和推理往往受到内存限制和稀疏线性代数工作负载的瓶颈。量子计算提供了一组替代原语，可以提高图学习的可扩展性。这项工作以 Liao \textit{et al.} 的量子图神经网络（QGNN）框架为基础，实现了两种代表性架构——简化图卷积（SGC）和线性图卷积（LGC）模型——并使用量子模拟在开放基准图数据集和半监督学习任务上对其进行评估。我们将预测性能和优化行为与经典基线进行比较，表明量子模型用更少的参数实现了有竞争力的性能。最后，我们提出了一种成本梯度分析，用于识别所展示的模型可训练的任务。接下来是经典的可模拟性研究，以找到所提出的电路在训练期间保持鲁棒性的机制。

title: Semiclassical scaling of eigenstate thermalization in single-particle chaotic systems
abstract: We study the off-diagonal matrix elements of real-space observables in time-reversal-invariant single-particle chaotic systems. By analyzing the semiclassical expression for the off-diagonal variance derived from Berry's conjecture, we show that the banded structure of the observable matrix emerges naturally. For local observables, we identify a characteristic bandwidth associated with a late-time timescale inversely proportional to the particle velocity. We further show that, for systems with steep-wall confinement, the predicted magnitude follows the entropy scaling of the eigenstate thermalization hypothesis (ETH), multiplied by an additional kinetic-energy-dependent factor that is independent of spatial dimension and is not captured by conventional many-body ETH. We illustrate these results through a case study of quantum billiards and verify the semiclassical scaling numerically in a generalized quarter-Sinai billiard. Our results elucidate the dynamical implications of Berry's conjecture and provide a comparison between single-particle eigenstate thermalization and many-body ETH.
summary: 我们研究时间反转不变单粒子混沌系统中实空间可观测量的非对角矩阵元素。通过分析贝里猜想导出的非对角方差的半经典表达式，我们表明可观察矩阵的带状结构自然出现。对于局部可观测值，我们确定了与粒子速度成反比的后期时间尺度相关的特征带宽。我们进一步表明，对于具有陡壁限制的系统，预测的幅度遵循本征态热化假说（ETH）的熵标度，乘以一个额外的动能相关因子，该因子与空间维度无关，并且不会被传统的多体 ETH 捕获。我们通过量子台球的案例研究来说明这些结果，并在广义的四分之一西奈台球中以数值方式验证半经典标度。我们的结果阐明了 Berry 猜想的动力学含义，并提供了单粒子本征态热化和多体 ETH 之间的比较。

title: Private communication from Pauli channels with no privacy
abstract: A channel capacity quantifies the communication capability of a noisy physical process. In contrast to communication channels in the classical world, quantum theory makes this capability contextual. We show that two Pauli two-qubit channels, each with zero private classical capacity, can be used to transmit private information when used together. One is a two-qubit Pauli channel whose environment can reconstruct the receiver output up to matrix transposition; the other is an antidegradable channel. We obtain a similar result when the second channel is the 50% qubit erasure channel. A simple binary code built from rank-three mixtures of Bell states activates private communication. The main ingredient in our construction is a transpose-antidegradable channel that is not antidegradable.
summary: 信道容量量化了噪声物理过程的通信能力。与经典世界中的通信渠道相比，量子理论使这种能力具有情境性。我们证明，两个保利二量子位通道（每个通道的私有经典容量为零）一起使用时可用于传输私有信息。一种是两个量子位泡利通道，其环境可以重构接收器输出直至矩阵转置；另一个是抗降解通道。当第二个通道是 50% 量子位擦除通道时，我们得到了类似的结果。由贝尔状态的三级混合构建的简单二进制代码可以激活私人通信。我们构建的主要成分是不可抗降解的转座抗降解通道。

title: Exceptional points and Jordan-chain signatures in quantum first-passage statistics
abstract: Exceptional-point signatures in first-passage observables are governed by two independent survival mechanisms: nonlinear spectral defectivity must pass from the one-record or transfer description to the physical one-level first-passage ladder, and the resulting ladder Jordan mode must have nonzero overlap with the chosen preparation and terminal observation. For finite reset-form monitored quantum systems with upward-skip-free counting, we prove the exact threshold factorization $H_N(s)=R_s^N$, identify the physical Perron branch, and derive the transfer factorization $Q_s(r)=B_s(r)(R_s-rI)$. Invertibility of the cofactor gives local equality of Smith data, whereas a singular cofactor can contribute transfer multiplicity absent from the ladder. An order-two Keldysh formula yields an independent observation gate. We then prove a fixed-reset no-go theorem: even a defective full tilted generator cannot generate a cumulative-count Jordan polynomial when the post-count ladder is scalar. Finally, we construct a three-reset monitored-Lindblad witness, minimal within irreducible nonnegative ladders, with a genuine subleading $N\lambda^N$ threshold term and a coherence-tuned model in which a binary terminal effect retains the exact polynomial signature at a transversal transform-domain exceptional point. The analysis is formulated at the level of exact transform-domain structure; time-domain asymptotics and perturbative robustness remain separate questions.
summary:
第一段可观测值中的异常点特征由两个独立的生存机制控制：非线性光谱缺陷必须从单记录或传输描述传递到物理单层第一段梯子，并且所得梯子乔丹模式必须与所选准备和最终观测具有非零重叠。对于具有向上跳跃自由计数的有限重置形式监控量子系统，我们证明了精确的阈值分解 $H_N(s)=R_s^N$，识别物理 Perron 分支，并推导了转移分解 $Q_s(r)=B_s(r)(R_s-rI)$。辅因子的可逆性给出了史密斯数据的局部相等性，而单一辅因子可以贡献梯子中缺少的转移多重性。二阶凯尔迪什公式产生一个独立的观察门。然后，我们证明了一个固定重置不可行定理：当后计数梯子是标量时，即使是有缺陷的全倾斜发生器也无法生成累积计数乔丹多项式。

最后，我们构建了一个三重置监控 Lindblad 见证，在不可约非负阶梯内最小，具有真正的次领先 $N\lambda^N$ 阈值项和一个相干调整模型，其中二元终端效应在横向变换域异常点保留了精确的多项式签名。该分析是在精确变换域结构的层面上制定的；时域渐近和微扰鲁棒性仍然是不同的问题。

title: QECirc: A Community-Driven, FAIR Library of Quantum Error Correction Circuits
abstract: Quantum error correction (QEC) underpins fault-tolerant quantum computing, but the circuits that realize QEC codes (encoders, logical state-preparation and gate routines, and syndrome-extraction schedules) are scattered across papers and one-off repositories in incompatible formats, often documented too sparsely to reconstruct or reuse. We present QECirc ( this https URL ), a community-driven, open library that makes QEC circuits Findable, Accessible, Interoperable, and Reusable (FAIR). Each entry links to its underlying code, ships in Stim and OpenQASM with interactive visualizations, and is checked for correctness before publication. In short, where a catalog such as the Error Correction Zoo describes the codes, QECirc provides the concrete circuits that realize them.
summary: 量子纠错（QEC）是容错量子计算的基础，但实现 QEC 代码（编码器、逻辑状态准备和门例程以及综合症提取时间表）的电路以不兼容的格式分散在论文和一次性存储库中，通常记录得太稀疏而无法重建或重用。我们推出 QECirc（此 https URL ），这是一个社区驱动的开放库，使 QEC 电路可查找、可访问、可互操作和可重用 (FAIR)。每个条目都链接到其底层代码，在 Stim 和 OpenQASM 中附带交互式可视化，并在发布前检查正确性。简而言之，纠错动物园等目录描述了代码，而 QECirc 提供了实现它们的具体电路。

title: Transformer fault diagnosis using an efficient simulation-driven variational quantum classifier with domain-aware feature encoding
abstract: Early transformer fault diagnosis is challenged by nonlinear dissolved-gas interactions, overlapping fault signatures, and limited labeled data, while practical deployment further requires reliable performance under realistic computational constraints. This paper presents a simulation-driven modeling framework for dissolved gas analysis-based transformer fault diagnosis, in which a carefully engineered variational quantum classifier (VQC) is employed as the computational core and systematically analyzed through simulation. The framework integrates domain-aware feature modeling derived from Duval geometry with a lightweight two-qubit quantum representation, enabling nonlinear gas-interaction effects to be captured within a shallow parameterized circuit. A hybrid ZX-YY quantum feature map is designed to model non-commuting feature interactions, while a full-entanglement EfficientSU2 ansatz provides adequate expressive capacity under strict resource limits. Model behavior is evaluated using a comprehensive simulation pipeline including noise-aware circuit emulation, cross-dataset validation, and limited hardware-in-the-loop execution, allowing key effects of circuit depth, noise, and optimization strategy to be examined. Simulation results on benchmark dissolved-gas-analysis datasets demonstrate high diagnostic accuracy, strong generalization capability, and robustness to realistic noise levels with minimal quantum resources. The results highlight the effectiveness of simulation-informed modeling for practical transformer diagnostic applications, offering a reproducible and resource-efficient pathway for evaluating quantum-enhanced fault diagnosis methods.
summary:
早期变压器故障诊断面临着非线性溶解气体相互作用、重叠故障特征和有限标记数据的挑战，而实际部署还需要在实际计算约束下具有可靠的性能。本文提出了一种基于溶解气体分析的变压器故障诊断的仿真驱动建模框架，其中采用精心设计的变分量子分类器（VQC）作为计算核心，并通过仿真进行系统分析。该框架将源自杜瓦尔几何的领域感知特征建模与轻量级双量子位量子表示相集成，从而能够在浅参数化电路中捕获非线性气体相互作用效应。混合 ZX-YY 量子特征图旨在模拟非通勤特征交互，而全纠缠 EfficientSU2 ansatz 在严格的资源限制下提供足够的表达能力。

使用全面的仿真管道评估模型行为，包括噪声感知电路仿真、跨数据集验证和有限的硬件在环执行，从而可以检查电路深度、噪声和优化策略的关键影响。基准溶解气体分析数据集的仿真结果表明，诊断精度高、泛化能力强，并且以最少的量子资源对实际噪声水平具有鲁棒性。结果突出了基于仿真的建模对于实际变压器诊断应用的有效性，为评估量子增强故障诊断方法提供了可重复且资源高效的途径。

title: Multiparameter sensing of axion dark matter with superconducting-qubit networks
abstract: We propose a quantum sensor network for direct detection of quantum chromodynamics (QCD) axion dark matter using entangled superconducting qubits. In the presence of a static magnetic field, the oscillating axion field induces a coherent qubit rotation described by an encoding angle proportional to the axion-photon coupling and an unknown dark-matter phase. Treating the phase as an additional unknown parameter turns axion detection into a two-parameter quantum estimation problem. We formulate these signals in Cartesian coordinates, thereby avoiding the singularity that arises in the weak-signal regime and establishing a regular framework for multiparameter quantum estimation. Using this framework, we optimize the quantum sensor network and combine it with Bayesian inference to reconstruct the axion-photon coupling. The optimized protocol accurately recovers the KSVZ and DFSZ benchmark couplings over the mass range $m_a\in[0.1,10]~\mu{\rm eV}$, generalizes to previously unseen masses, and remains robust against realistic superconducting-qubit decoherence and gate errors.
summary: 我们提出了一种量子传感器网络，用于使用纠缠超导量子位直接检测量子色动力学（QCD）轴子暗物质。在存在静磁场的情况下，振荡轴子场会引起相干量子位旋转，该旋转由与轴子-光子耦合成比例的编码角和未知的暗物质相位来描述。将相位视为附加的未知参数将轴子检测变成了双参数量子估计问题。我们在笛卡尔坐标中表示这些信号，从而避免了弱信号状态中出现的奇异性，并建立了多参数量子估计的规则框架。使用该框架，我们优化了量子传感器网络并将其与贝叶斯推理相结合以重建轴子-光子耦合。优化的协议准确地恢复了质量范围 $m_a\in[0.1,10]~\mu{\rm eV}$ 上的 KSVZ 和 DFSZ 基准耦合，推广到以前未见过的质量，并且对现实的超导量子位退相干和门错误保持鲁棒性。

title: QEncodeBench: Can Large Language Models Encode Classical Problems into Verified Quantum Oracles?
abstract: Grover search, amplitude amplification, and quantum counting all rely on the same reusable subroutine, a phase oracle, whose construction the algorithms literature takes as given: the classical predicate is assumed to be already encoded as a correct, resource-bounded circuit. We turn this assumption into a measured capability. QEncodeBench tasks large language models (LLMs) with encoding classical constraint problems as phase oracles and scores the generated circuits with an adversarially self-validated verifier that decides full solution-set equivalence up to a global phase, with ancillas restored and resource budgets enforced. Sampled basis-state tests, we show, systematically overestimate this ability. Measured this way, models separate sharply: code models without a reasoning mode solve essentially nothing, and enabling native reasoning on identical weights improves accuracy by an order of magnitude. The failures are overwhelmingly semantic rather than syntactic. Two architectures, a unit-verified constraint agent and a neuro-symbolic compilation pipeline, close most of the remaining gap by delegating correctness-critical composition to deterministic procedures. Ablations quantify the contribution of each component, and resource gating exposes an architecture-dependent trade-off between circuit width and depth. Finally, controlled difficulty escalation reveals architecture-specific responses to difficulty structure: different difficulty axes degrade different methods, while the neuro-symbolic pipeline passes every evaluated instance. Code and data are available at this https URL .
summary:
格罗弗搜索、振幅放大和量子计数都依赖于相同的可重用子程序，即相位预言机，算法文献采用的构造是给定的：假设经典谓词已经被编码为正确的、资源有限的电路。我们将这个假设转化为可测量的能力。 QEncodeBench 将经典约束问题编码为阶段预言，对大型语言模型 (LLM) 进行任务，并使用对抗性自我验证验证器对生成的电路进行评分，该验证器决定全局阶段的完整解决方案集等效性，同时恢复辅助并强制执行资源预算。我们表明，抽样的基态测试系统地高估了这种能力。通过这种方式衡量，模型之间的差异很大：没有推理模式的代码模型基本上什么也解决不了，而在相同权重上启用本机推理可以将准确性提高一个数量级。绝大多数的失败是语义上的而不是语法上的。两种架构，一个单元验证的约束代理和一个神经符号编译管道，通过将正确性关键的组合委托给确定性过程来弥补大部分剩余的差距。

消融量化了每个组件的贡献，资源门控揭示了电路宽度和深度之间依赖于架构的权衡。最后，受控难度升级揭示了架构特定对难度结构的响应：不同的难度轴降低了不同的方法，而神经符号管道通过每个评估的实例。代码和数据可在此 https URL 获取。

title: Divergence Geometry of Quantum Multi-Mpemba Effects
abstract: Whether a quantum Mpemba effect occurs can depend on how distance from stationarity is measured. We show that agreement across normalized operator-convex Petz divergences is decided by a one-parameter $\chi^2$ profile. Its sign fixes the common order, alternating sign margins guarantee repeated crossings, and finite dimension yields a polynomial positivity test. The same profile explains diagnostic-independent late-time order for a simple real slow mode and isolates coherence as the local source of diagnostic dependence. In a trapped-ion qutrit ideal model, the reported preparation gives diagnostic-selective crossings, while a nearby preparation is a floating-point candidate for two family-wide reversals. The framework turns diagnostic robustness into a tractable control problem.
summary: 量子姆彭巴效应是否发生取决于如何测量与静止状态的距离。我们证明，标准化算子凸 Petz 散度之间的一致性是由单参数 $\chi^2$ 轮廓决定的。它的符号固定了公共顺序，交替的符号边距保证了重复交叉，有限维产生了多项式正性检验。相同的配置文件解释了简单实慢模式的独立于诊断的后期顺序，并将一致性隔离为诊断依赖性的本地来源。在捕获离子 qutrit 理想模型中，报告的制备物提供诊断选择性交叉，而附近的制备物是两个全族逆转的浮点候选者。该框架将诊断稳健性转变为易于处理的控制问题。

title: Entanglement Dynamics in Katz-Weighted Graph States
abstract: We investigate the entanglement dynamics of quantum states defined on graphs with non-local Ising interactions governed by the Katz kernel of the underlying network. The interaction pattern is physically motivated by a gapped fermionic mediator propagating on the same graph, whose perturbative elimination yields an effective Katz-weighted Ising Hamiltonian. Using the Entanglement Distance, we derive an exact analytical expression for the entanglement generated from an initially separable state and apply it to representative deterministic graph families. We then characterize the dynamics in different propagation regimes. In the weak-Katz regime, the dynamics admits a systematic motif expansion with triangles entering at first order order and four-cycles, local degree structure, and overlappin triangles appearing at second order. In the strong-propagation regime, the interaction is instead dominated by the principal adjacency mode and by the localization properties of its eigenvector. For Erdős--Rényi graphs, the weak-propagation expansion can be averaged analytically, revealing a locally tree-like contribution in the sparse regime and saturation of the Entanglement Distance density in the dense regime. Our results connect entanglement dynamics with both the walk-based and spectral structure of complex networks.
summary:
我们研究了图上定义的量子态的纠缠动力学，该图具有由底层网络的 Katz 核控制的非局域 Ising 相互作用。相互作用模式是由在同一图上传播的有隙费米子介体物理驱动的，其微扰消除产生有效的卡茨加权伊辛哈密顿量。使用纠缠距离，我们得出了从初始可分离状态生成的纠缠的精确解析表达式，并将其应用于代表性的确定性图族。然后我们描述不同传播机制中的动态特征。在弱卡茨体系中，动力学允许系统主题扩展，三角形进入一阶和四循环，局部度结构和重叠三角形出现在二阶。在强传播机制中，相互作用由主要邻接模式及其特征向量的局部化特性主导。

对于 Erdős-Rényi 图，可以对弱传播展开进行分析平均，揭示稀疏区域中的局部树状贡献以及密集区域中纠缠距离密度的饱和。我们的结果将纠缠动力学与复杂网络的基于行走和谱结构联系起来。

title: State-Selective Floquet Memory in Degenerate Manifolds
abstract: In order to understand which initial states retain memory under periodic driving, it is necessary to depart from the ideal limit giving rise to invariant structures and work inside near-degenerate manifolds. We show that degeneracy itself is not conclusive and what actually matters is how perturbations, such as structural and driving imperfections, acts on the projected multiplet. For systems decoupling into the local clusters in the ideal limit, the projections can be computed within degenerate perturbation theory. There the stability is decided by two criteria: the coupling can not connect the state with other degenerate partners in the manifold, either by kinetic blocking, or more generally, by diagonalizing the projected coupling, and the drive's local selection rule must admit only transfer energies detuned from Floquet sidebands, in which case the projected drive generator exactly vanishes. We formalize these understandings in a periodically driven clean, short-ranged alternating XXZ chain and demonstrate a set of results that include, long-lived states, both of product form and entangled across the clusters, a periodic family of sideband resonances, and an explicit example showing opposite fates for states with identical energy and charges.
summary:
为了了解哪些初始状态在周期性驱动下保留记忆，有必要偏离产生不变结构的理想极限并在近简并流形内工作。我们证明简并性本身并不是决定性的，真正重要的是结构和驱动缺陷等扰动如何作用于预计的多重态。对于在理想极限下解耦到局部簇的系统，可以在简并扰动理论中计算投影。稳定性由两个标准决定：耦合不能通过动力学阻塞或更一般地通过对角化投影耦合来将状态与流形中的其他简并伙伴连接起来，并且驱动器的局部选择规则必须只允许从 Floquet 边带传递失谐能量，在这种情况下投影驱动生成器完全消失。

我们将这些理解形式化在周期性驱动的清洁、短程交替 XXZ 链中，并展示了一系列结果，其中包括长寿命状态（产品形式和跨簇纠缠）、边带共振的周期性族，以及显示具有相同能量和电荷的状态相反命运的明确示例。

title: VQE Validation on the Mononuclear T1 (Blue-Copper) Site: A Stepping Stone to the Multi-Copper Laccase Cluster
abstract: Validating variational quantum eigensolver (VQE) pipelines on realistic chemical systems is a critical stepping stone toward tackling classically intractable molecules. In this work, we report emulator-based validation of the VQE workflow proposed for the copper active site, executed on the LRZ Eviden Qaptiva emulator. A problem-tailored ADAPT-VQE with a full singles-doubles-triples (S+D+T) pool removes over 99% of the correlation error, reaching a stable plateau at 4.03 mEh relative to exact diagonalisation (148 selected operators). This establishes a >40x improvement over the hardware-efficient ansatz (HEA). Finally, we frame these emulator results as a robust baseline for upcoming physical quantum hardware runs on Euro-Q-Exa.
summary: 在现实化学系统上验证变分量子本征求解器 (VQE) 管道是解决经典棘手分子问题的关键垫脚石。在这项工作中，我们报告了针对铜活性位点提出的基于模拟器的 VQE 工作流程验证，该工作流程在 LRZ Eviden Qaptiva 模拟器上执行。具有完整单双三 (S+D+T) 池的针对问题定制的 ADAPT-VQE 消除了超过 99% 的相关误差，相对于精确对角化（148 个选定算子）达到 4.03 mEh 的稳定平台。这比硬件效率 ansatz (HEA) 提高了 40 倍以上。最后，我们将这些模拟器结果作为即将在 Euro-Q-Exa 上运行的物理量子硬件的可靠基准。

title: Technical Report OFDM-Assisted Simultaneous Quantum and Classical THz Communications
abstract: The feasibility of cost-effective simultaneous quantum and classical communication (SQCC) transmitting both the quantum key and classical information via a superimposed coherent state is investigated both in optical and Terahertz (THz) bands. Since the existing THz SQCC schemes assume single-carrier (SC) transmission over flat fading channels, we embark on investigating SQCC in realistic frequency-selective multipath THz fading channels. We then propose an orthogonal frequency division multiplexing (OFDM) based SQCC system for time-invariant frequency-selective THz scenarios, supported by low-density parity-check coded (LDPC) multidimensional QKD reconciliation schemes. Our simulation results demonstrate that the OFDM-based SQCC scheme is capable of achieving a practical secret key rate (SKR) over a wide range of power sharing scenarios between the classical and quantum signals. By contrast its single-carrier counterpart requires the classical signal to be at least 100 times stronger than the quantum signal in THz SQCC.
summary: 研究了在光学和太赫兹 (THz) 频段中通过叠加相干态传输量子密钥和经典信息的经济高效的同步量子和经典通信 (SQCC) 的可行性。由于现有的太赫兹 SQCC 方案假设在平坦衰落信道上进行单载波 (SC) 传输，因此我们开始研究现实频率选择性多径太赫兹衰落信道中的 SQCC。然后，我们提出了一种基于正交频分复用（OFDM）的SQCC系统，用于时不变频率选择性太赫兹场景，并由低密度奇偶校验编码（LDPC）多维QKD协调方案支持。我们的仿真结果表明，基于 OFDM 的 SQCC 方案能够在经典信号和量子信号之间的各种功率共享场景中实现实用的密钥速率 (SKR)。相比之下，其单载波对应物要求经典信号至少比 THz SQCC 中的量子信号强 100 倍。

title: Scalable logical qubits
abstract: Utility-scale quantum computing will require executing long, complex algorithms with end-to-end error rates far below what physical qubits can support directly. Error-corrected logical qubits are needed to achieve this goal. To make the progress on logical qubits measurable and comparable we introduce the definition of scalable logical qubits: logical qubits preserved for long computations by repeated quantum error correction, capable of fault-tolerant universal operations with low-latency real-time decoding and feedback, and replicable to the hundreds or thousands, as required by applications. We characterize these scalable logical qubits along four coupled dimensions: reliability, scale, capability, and performance, and discuss trade-offs among these dimensions.
summary: 公用事业规模的量子计算将需要执行长而复杂的算法，其端到端错误率远低于物理量子位可以直接支持的水平。实现这一目标需要纠错逻辑量子位。为了使逻辑量子位的进展可测量和可比较，我们引入了可扩展逻辑量子位的定义：通过重复量子纠错保留长时间计算的逻辑量子位，能够通过低延迟实时解码和反馈进行容错通用操作，并且可以根据应用程序的需要复制到数百或数千个。我们沿着四个耦合维度来描述这些可扩展的逻辑量子位：可靠性、规模、能力和性能，并讨论这些维度之间的权衡。

title: FT-Weave: Real-Time Compilation Framework for Reconfigurable Fault-Tolerant Quantum Architectures
abstract: Fault-tolerant quantum computing (FTQC) is essential for large-scale quantum computation, but realizing useful application throughput requires coordinating resource preparation, assignment, routing, and logical execution under strict hardware and timing constraints. Many FTQC compilation approaches construct offline schedules using nominal or fixed magic-state factory throughput. Such schedules cannot respond to stochastic resource-preparation and teleportation outcomes, leading to execution stalls and hardware underutilization. In this work, we introduce FT-Weave, a stage-aware real-time FTQC compilation framework that jointly coordinates resource preparation, resource assignment, teleportation routing, and correction handling. By adapting to runtime resource availability and hardware constraints, FT-Weave allows preparation, communication, and logical execution to overlap. We instantiate FT-Weave on two representative neutral-atom, early FTQC architectures: transversal STAR and a T-state cultivation architecture. Under the evaluated hardware and latency model, FT-Weave achieves a speedup of up to 3X over a baseline compilation flow for simulations of the two-dimensional transverse-field Ising model. In the case study, we further find that maximizing exposed concurrency does not necessarily minimize execution time. Although fine-grained asynchronous execution can reduce local idle time, its smaller optimization windows and increased routing contention can outweigh these gains. Together, these results show that effective runtime coordination, rather then exposed parallelism alone, determines how efficiently FTQC resources translate into application throughput:FT-Weave provides a blueprint for solving this real-time orchestration problem across resource protocols and architectures.
summary:
容错量子计算（FTQC）对于大规模量子计算至关重要，但实现有用的应用程序吞吐量需要在严格的硬件和时序约束下协调资源准备、分配、路由和逻辑执行。许多 FTQC 编译方法使用标称或固定幻状态工厂吞吐量构建离线计划。此类调度无法响应随机资源准备和传送结果，从而导致执行停顿和硬件利用率不足。在这项工作中，我们介绍了 FT-Weave，这是一种阶段感知的实时 FTQC 编译框架，可以联合协调资源准备、资源分配、传送路由和校正处理。通过适应运行时资源可用性和硬件限制，FT-Weave 允许准备、通信和逻辑执行重叠。我们在两个代表性的中性原子、早期 FTQC 架构上实例化 FT-Weave：横向 STAR 和 T 状态培养架构。

在评估的硬件和延迟模型下，FT-Weave 比二维横向场 Ising 模型模拟的基线编译流程实现了高达 3 倍的加速。在案例研究中，我们进一步发现最大化公开并发并不一定最小化执行时间。尽管细粒度异步执行可以减少本地空闲时间，但其较小的优化窗口和增加的路由争用可能会抵消这些收益。总之，这些结果表明，有效的运行时协调（而不是单独暴露的并行性）决定了 FTQC 资源如何有效地转化为应用程序吞吐量：FT-Weave 提供了解决跨资源协议和架构的实时编排问题的蓝图。

title: Quantum Noise Limited Nonlinear Phase-Preserving Amplification of a Bosonic Mode
abstract: Does quantum mechanics allow for deterministic amplification schemes that simultaneously behave uniformly for all angles of bosonic phase space (i.e. phase preserving) and are nonlinear in the underlying field operators? Would such a scheme have some utility to quantum information science? In this paper we answer both questions with a resounding yes. Such amplifiers exist, but their form is highly constrained compared to the more general set of noise limited nonlinear amplifiers previously studied in the literature. This enables us to characterize the entire class of bosonic noise-limited nonlinear phase preserving amplifiers, and identify their utility: namely, the optimal amplification of Yurke-Stoler cat states and Kerr kitten states.
summary: 量子力学是否允许确定性放大方案同时对玻色相空间的所有角度表现一致（即相位保持）并且在基础场算子中是非线性的？这样的方案对量子信息科学有一些用处吗？在本文中，我们对这两个问题的回答都是肯定的。这种放大器是存在的，但与文献中先前研究的更通用的噪声受限非线性放大器相比，它们的形式受到高度限制。这使我们能够表征整个类别的玻色噪声限制非线性保相放大器，并确定它们的效用：即 Yurke-Stoler 猫态和 Kerr 小猫态的最佳放大。

title: Hardness of Pathfinding in a Welded Tree
abstract: Starting from the entrance of a welded tree, a quantum walk algorithm can find its exit vertex exponentially faster than any classical algorithm. However, it has been an open question whether any quantum algorithm is able to efficiently find a path from the entrance to the exit. We answer this by proving an exponential quantum query lower bound for finding such path. Specifically, for trees of height $n$, any quantum query algorithm requires at least $\Omega(2^{n/24})$ queries in order to succeed with constant probability. Our proof uses the compressed permutation oracle technique in order to construct databases which track the graph information an algorithm has learned and forgotten, and show that no efficient quantum algorithm can build an entrance-to-exit path in these records.
summary: 从焊接树的入口开始，量子行走算法可以比任何经典算法更快地找到其出口顶点。然而，任何量子算法是否能够有效地找到从入口到出口的路径一直是一个悬而未决的问题。我们通过证明寻找此类路径的指数量子查询下界来回答这个问题。具体来说，对于高度为 $n$ 的树，任何量子查询算法至少需要 $\Omega(2^{n/24})$ 查询才能以恒定概率成功。我们的证明使用压缩排列预言技术来构建数据库，该数据库跟踪算法已学习和忘记的图形信息，并表明没有有效的量子算法可以在这些记录中构建入口到出口路径。

title: Multinegativity and single-letter formulas for asymptotic entanglement
abstract: The study of entanglement inevitably leads to the concept of regularization, where measures are evaluated on infinitely many copies of a state. Single-letter formulas try to make these asymptotic entanglement quantities accessible through a calculation on one copy of a state, but are rarely available. We introduce a decreasing hierarchy of computable upper bounds on the asymptotic relative entropy of entanglement with respect to positive-partial-transpose (PPT) states. The regularization of every fixed hierarchy level equals this asymptotic quantity. Additivity at any level therefore yields a single-letter formula, even when the usual one-copy relative entropy is nonadditive. We establish such additivity at the first nontrivial level for two broad multiparameter families, both containing all Werner states. The upper-bound construction also extends to sandwiched Renyi divergences. The hierarchy motivates $k$-multinegative states, a generalization of binegative states and the associated $k$-multinegativity, which gives explicit upper bounds on both the asymptotic relative entropy and exact PPT entanglement cost. We construct states which are $k$-multinegative at arbitrarily large depths $k$ that separate consecutive levels of the previously introduced entanglement-cost hierarchy, disproving its conjectured finite collapse. These results provide state-dependent single-letter formulas while identifying a limitation of universal finite-level characterizations.
summary:
对纠缠的研究不可避免地引出了正则化的概念，即在状态的无限多个副本上评估度量。单字母公式试图通过对状态的一个副本进行计算来获取这些渐近纠缠量，但很少可用。我们引入了关于正部分转置（PPT）态的纠缠渐近相对熵的可计算上限的递减层次结构。每个固定层级的正则化等于这个渐近量。因此，任何级别的可加性都会产生单字母公式，即使通常的单拷贝相对熵是非可加性的。我们在两个广泛的多参数族的第一个非平凡水平上建立了这种可加性，这两个多参数族都包含所有维尔纳状态。上限构造还延伸到夹在中间的 Renyi 背离。该层次结构激发了 $k$-多重负态，这是双负态和相关的 $k$-多重负性的概括，它给出了渐近相对熵和精确 PPT 纠缠成本的明确上限。

我们在任意大的深度 $k$ 处构造了 $k$-多重负的状态，这些状态将先前引入的纠缠成本层次结构的连续级别分开，从而反驳了其推测的有限崩溃。这些结果提供了状态相关的单字母公式，同时确定了通用有限级表征的局限性。

title: Quantum Simulation of Dissipative Non-Markovian Coupled Classical Oscillators
abstract: We present a quantum algorithm for simulating classical oscillator networks characterized by non-Markovian dissipation and time-varying material properties, extending recent speedups for undamped harmonic systems to viscoacoustic and viscoelastic media. We embed the history-dependent dynamics into a Markovian state space governed by a non-Hermitian operator by approximating memory kernels through a Prony series. We then use linear combination of Hamiltonian simulation to estimate the instantaneous kinetic and potential energy for a subset of oscillators at time $t$ within error $\epsilon$ using a number of queries to the oscillator system that scales as $\widetilde{\mathcal{O}}(\alpha_{\rm tot} t/\epsilon)$, where $\alpha_{\rm tot}$ is polynomial in the strength of the dissipation, spring constants, inverse masses, and sparsity of the connections in the network. We further show that this energy estimation task is in the worst-case classically hard (i.e., a corresponding decision problem is $\mathsf{BQP}$-complete), even in the presence of strong dissipation. For time-dependent materials, we show that changes in material properties appear as effective dissipation or growth in the energy representation. Additionally, we prove the infeasibility of exponential quantum advantages in locally coupled topologies through a novel form of Lieb-Robinson-like bounds that apply to differential equations. This allows our quantum algorithms to provide quartic speedups for locally coupled damped oscillator systems in three dimensions, raising the possibility of practical quantum speedups for realistically damped oscillator networks and approximated wave equations.
summary:
我们提出了一种用于模拟以非马尔可夫耗散和时变材料特性为特征的经典振荡器网络的量子算法，将无阻尼谐波系统的最新加速扩展到粘声和粘弹性介质。我们通过 Prony 级数逼近内存内核，将历史相关动力学嵌入到由非厄米算子控制的马尔可夫状态空间中。然后，我们使用哈密顿模拟的线性组合来估计振荡器子集在时间 $t$ 的瞬时动能和势能，误差范围为 $\epsilon$，使用对振荡器系统的大量查询，该系统缩放为 $\widetilde{\mathcal{O}}(\alpha_{\rm tot} t/\epsilon)$，其中 $\alpha_{\rm tot}$ 是耗散强度、弹簧常数、逆质量和网络中连接的稀疏性。我们进一步表明，即使存在强耗散，这种能量估计任务在最坏情况下也是经典困难的（即相应的决策问题是$\mathsf{BQP}$-complete）。

对于时间相关材料，我们表明材料属性的变化表现为能量表示的有效耗散或增长。此外，我们通过适用于微分方程的新型利布-罗宾逊式界限证明了局部耦合拓扑中指数量子优势的不可行性。这使得我们的量子算法能够为三维局部耦合阻尼振荡器系统提供四次加速，从而提高了实际阻尼振荡器网络和近似波动方程的实际量子加速的可能性。

title: Blind Quantum Computation with a Small Quantum Server
abstract: Blind quantum computation (BQC) allows low-resource clients to securely delegate computations to a quantum server, but server resource costs scale with the computation size, posing a bottleneck for implementations. By leveraging Pauli-based computation (PBC), we achieve BQC with a server whose size depends only on the non-Clifford gate count. Our protocol inherits fault tolerance and qubit virtualization from PBC and reveals that classical-client BQC is possible even in the absence of classical simulability. Finally, we present an entanglement-based dual protocol that performs a resource state computation with a dramatically reduced execution cost.
summary: 盲量子计算（BQC）允许资源匮乏的客户端安全地将计算委托给量子服务器，但服务器资源成本随着计算规模的增加而增加，这给实现带来了瓶颈。通过利用基于 Pauli 的计算 (PBC)，我们使用服务器实现 BQC，该服务器的大小仅取决于非 Clifford 门数。我们的协议继承了 PBC 的容错和量子比特虚拟化，并揭示了即使在缺乏经典可模拟性的情况下，经典客户端 BQC 也是可能的。最后，我们提出了一种基于纠缠的双重协议，该协议可以显着降低执行成本来执行资源状态计算。

title: Efficient Non-Uniform Quantum Hermite Transform through Adaptive Sampling
abstract: On the span of the first $N$ oscillator modes, Gauss--Hermite quadrature gives an exact change of basis between mode coefficients and $N$ weighted position space samples. We implement this transform with $O(N\operatorname{polylog}(N,1/\varepsilon))$ logical gates and polylogarithmic quantum width. The operator-error bound $\varepsilon$ holds on arbitrary superpositions and includes all auxiliary registers. The construction uses signed averages on adaptive windows to convert uniform-grid samples into weighted Hermite-root samples. Their varying widths control the amplification cost, giving the near-linear bound.
summary: 在第一个 $N$ 振荡器模式的跨度上，高斯-埃尔米特求积给出了模式系数和 $N$ 加权位置空间样本之间的基础的精确变化。我们使用 $O(N\operatorname{polylog}(N,1/\varepsilon))$ 逻辑门和多对数量子宽度来实现此变换。运算符错误界限 $\varepsilon$ 保留任意叠加并包括所有辅助寄存器。该结构使用自适应窗口上的有符号平均值将均匀网格样本转换为加权 Hermite 根样本。它们不同的宽度控制着放大成本，给出了接近线性的界限。

title: Mermin-Peres magic rectangles modulo odd primes
abstract: The Mermin-Peres magic square provides a simple example of a system of linear equations over $\mathbb{Z}/2\mathbb{Z}$ which has no classical solutions but does have a finite-dimensional operator solution. For a long time, it was not known how to construct similar examples over $\mathbb{Z}/d\mathbb{Z}$ with $d$ odd. In this paper, we construct, for every integer $d\ge2$, a linear system over $\mathbb{Z}/d\mathbb{Z}$ that has a finite-dimensional operator solution but no classical solution. For an odd prime $p$, our operators act on two $p$-dimensional qudits and generate a finite $p$-group obtained by adjoining diagonal polynomial phase operators to the generalized Pauli group. Classical inconsistency follows from an elementary linearity argument comparing assignments on abelian subgroups.
summary: Mermin-Peres 幻方提供了 $\mathbb{Z}/2\mathbb{Z}$ 上的线性方程组的简单示例，它没有经典解，但有有限维算子解。很长一段时间，我们不知道如何在 $\mathbb{Z}/d\mathbb{Z}$ 和 $d$ 奇数上构造类似的例子。在本文中，我们为每个整数 $d\ge2$ 构造一个 $\mathbb{Z}/d\mathbb{Z}$ 上的线性系统，该系统具有有限维算子解，但没有经典解。对于奇素数 $p$，我们的算子作用于两个 $p$ 维量子，并生成一个有限 $p$ 组，该组是通过将对角多项式相位算子与广义泡利群相邻而获得的。经典的不一致源于比较阿贝尔子群的分配的基本线性论证。

title: Quantum Entropy Contraction and Factorization from Hypercontractivity
abstract: We prove that hypercontractivity implies entropy contraction for a single quantum channel, without a detailed balance condition. For primitive quantum Markov semigroups that are KMS-symmetric with respect to a faithful invariant state \(\sigma\), we obtain the modified Log-Sobolev bound $\alpha_1\geq \frac{\lambda}{(2+\log\|\sigma^{-1}\|_\infty)}$ where $\lambda$ is the spectral gap. This removes the assumption of \(L_p\)-regularity for the comparison through the log-Sobolev constant. As an application, we show that the hypercontractivity of an average of two conditional expectations implies the approximate tensorization of relative entropy.
summary: 我们证明超收缩性意味着单个量子通道的熵收缩，而无需详细的平衡条件。对于关于忠实不变状态 \(\sigma\) 是 KMS 对称的原始量子马尔可夫半群，我们获得修改后的 Log-Sobolev 界 $\alpha_1\geq \frac{\lambda}{(2+\log\|\sigma^{-1}\|_\infty)}$，其中 $\lambda$ 是谱间隙。这消除了通过 log-Sobolev 常数进行比较的 \(L_p\) 规律性假设。作为一个应用，我们证明了两个条件期望平均值的超收缩性意味着相对熵的近似张量化。

title: Procrastinating einselection in non-Markovian quantum dynamics
abstract: Among the processes governed by open-system and dissipative quantum dynamics, environment-induced superselection, or einselection, is particularly foundational, since it describes the formation of a preferred set of pointer states through environmental monitoring and ultimately the emergence of classicality. Especially in the context of Quantum Darwinism, einselection can be studied in terms of the motion of an observable towards its pointer value. To this end, we derive a quantum speed limit for observables for finite-dimensional systems governed by differentiable time-local open dynamics. We identify two mechanisms through which non-Markovianity can enhance observable speed: direct dissipative motion supported by population retention or revival, and indirect enhancement through restoration of the asymmetry available for coherent motion. For permanent einselection, this delays the emergence of the pointer basis due to accumulated negativity.
summary: 在开放系统和耗散量子动力学控制的过程中，环境引起的超选择或电子选择尤其重要，因为它描述了通过环境监测形成一组首选指针状态以及最终经典性的出现。特别是在量子达尔文主义的背景下，可以根据可观察到的指针值的运动来研究选择。为此，我们推导了由可微时间局部开放动力学控制的有限维系统的可观测量的量子速度极限。我们确定了非马尔可夫性可以提高可观测速度的两种机制：由群体保留或复兴支持的直接耗散运动，以及通过恢复可用于相干运动的不对称性来间接增强。对于永久选择，由于累积的负值，这延迟了指针基础的出现。

title: All causally separable quantum processes are quantum circuits with classical control of causal order
abstract: The concept of causal (non)separability describes whether the causal order between parties that perform local quantum operations is well-defined or indefinite. Causal (non)separability in the general multipartite setting was introduced and studied in [Oreshkov and Giarmatzi, New J. Phys. 18, 093020 (2016); Wechs, Abbott, and Branciard, New J. Phys. 21, 013027 (2019)]. We resolve an open problem from these earlier works by showing -- using a novel "coherent teleportation technique" -- that a sufficient condition for causal separability identified in [Wechs, Abbott, and Branciard, New J. Phys. 21, 013027 (2019)] is also necessary, and thus provides a complete characterisation of multipartite causal separability. A consequence of this result is that all causally separable processes admit a realisation as generalised quantum circuits in which the order between the operations is classically controlled, known as "quantum circuits with classical control of causal order".
summary: 因果（不可）分离的概念描述了执行局部量子操作的各方之间的因果顺序是明确定义的还是不确定的。一般多部分环境中的因果（不可）分离性在 [Oreshkov 和 Giarmatzi，New J. Phys. 18、093020（2016）；韦克斯、雅培和布兰西亚德，《新物理学杂志》。 21, 013027 (2019)]。我们通过使用一种新颖的“相干隐形传态技术”来解决这些早期作品中的一个开放问题，在[Wechs、Abbott 和 Branciard，New J. Phys. 21, 013027 (2019)]也是必要的，因此提供了多部分因果可分离性的完整表征。这一结果的结果是，所有因果可分离的过程都承认作为广义量子电路的实现，其中操作之间的顺序是经典控制的，称为“具有因果顺序经典控制的量子电路”。

title: Asymptotically Good Quantum Locally Testable Codes
abstract: We construct explicit families of asymptotically good quantum locally testable codes over qubits. More precseily, we construct explicit quantum LDPC CSS codes over qubits having constant rate, constant relative distance and constant weight local testers with constant soundness.
summary: 我们在量子位上构造渐近良好的量子局部可测试代码的显式族。更准确地说，我们在具有恒定速率、恒定相对距离和恒定稳健性的恒定权重本地测试器的量子位上构造显式量子 LDPC CSS 代码。

title: Parallel quantum channel discrimination and numerical ranges in tensor product subspaces
abstract: Quantum channel discrimination plays a crucial role in quantum information theory. Of particular interest is the case in which the channels can be discriminated perfectly. In this work, we focus on the perfect quantum channel discrimination task in a parallel scheme. We develop an SDP formulation combined with a bisection procedure to compute a quantum state for perfect discrimination in time linear in the number of copies. In addition, we obtain the minimal number of copies of quantum channels to achieve perfect discrimination. Thanks to that, we settle in the affirmative Conjecture 1 of Duan, Guo, Li and Li [ arXiv:1605.02294 , IEEE ISIT 2016], which characterizes the number of parallel uses needed to discriminate perfectly a distinguished family of operator subspaces. All our results are obtained using the notion and basic properties of the numerical range. In particular, the key fact that we prove and use is that the minimal angle of the numerical range of a tensor product of matrix subspaces equals the sum of the minimal angles of the numerical ranges of the individual subspaces.
summary: 量子通道辨别在量子信息论中起着至关重要的作用。特别令人感兴趣的是可以完美地区分通道的情况。在这项工作中，我们专注于并行方案中的完美量子通道辨别任务。我们开发了一种与二分程序相结合的 SDP 公式来计算量子态，以实现与副本数量呈线性的时间完美判别。此外，我们获得了最少数量的量子通道副本以实现完美的辨别。因此，我们得出了 Duan、Guo、Li 和 Li 的肯定猜想 1 [ arXiv:1605.02294 ，IEEE ISIT 2016 ]，它描述了完美区分算子子空间的杰出家族所需的并行使用数量。我们所有的结果都是利用数值范围的概念和基本属性获得的。特别是，我们证明和使用的关键事实是矩阵子空间的张量乘积的数值范围的最小角度等于各个子空间的数值范围的最小角度之和。

title: Locally optimized variational evolution for quantum many-body systems
abstract: Conventional quantum advantage in many-body dynamics is based on avoiding the simulation cost on a classical computer that arises from the extensive exponential complexity of the global wavefunction. Local observables, however, do not inherit this extensive complexity and may instead be governed by an intrinsic local complexity that is independent of the total system size. This distinction is particularly relevant in thermalising systems, where local observables lose memory of microscopic details and relax towards equilibrium values determined by only a few parameters. Here we introduce a variational time-evolution principle that exploits this distinction by replacing global-state fidelity with a cost function defined on local reduced density matrices. The resulting evolution retains coherent short-time dynamics while exploiting the simplification produced by thermalisation at later times. The concrete algorithm we propose is based on locally optimising matrix-product states and admits closed-form equations of motion analogous to the time-dependent variational principle. We show that the same variational principle has a quantum-classical counterpart, combining quantum evaluation of the local cost with an optimisation strategy robust to both shot and hardware noise. Proof-of-principle implementations on Quantinuum H2 and IBM Heron processors recover the characteristic local dynamics.
summary:
多体动力学中的传统量子优势是基于避免经典计算机上因全局波函数的广泛指数复杂性而产生的模拟成本。然而，局部可观察量不会继承这种广泛的复杂性，而是可能受到独立于总系统大小的固有局部复杂性的控制。这种区别在热化系统中尤其重要，在热化系统中，局部可观测值会失去对微观细节的记忆，并放松到仅由几个参数确定的平衡值。在这里，我们引入了一种变分时间演化原理，该原理通过用局部约简密度矩阵上定义的成本函数替换全局状态保真度来利用这种区别。由此产生的演化保留了连贯的短时动态，同时利用了后期热化产生的简化。我们提出的具体算法基于局部优化矩阵乘积状态，并允许类似于时间相关变分原理的闭式运动方程。

我们证明，相同的变分原理有一个量子经典对应物，它将局部成本的量子评估与对散粒噪声和硬件噪声都稳健的优化策略相结合。 Quantinuum H2 和 IBM Heron 处理器上的原理验证实现恢复了特有的局部动态。

title: Environment Alignment and Redundant Record Formation in Imperfect-CNOT Quantum Darwinism
abstract: Quantum Darwinism explains objective information through redundant environmental records. Earlier work established that imperfect records can be amplified and that environment self-evolution can enhance or suppress their formation. We investigate how preparation, interaction angle, and field disorder combine in an imperfect-CNOT model with random Gaussian couplings and pure, noninteracting environment qubits. We find that, without fields, a single alignment parameter $\Lambda$ determines the preparation and interaction-angle dependence of conditional-state distinguishability. Increasing interaction imperfection or local field strength can improve or suppress recording. We explain this nonmonotonic response through the geometry of conditional branch separation. For the pure initial environments considered here, the $Z$ basis remains optimal for Holevo information, so field-assisted recording requires no change of the recorded system observable. Comparing uniform local field strengths with Gaussian-distributed strengths at equal root-mean-square strength shows how disorder broadens both beneficial and detrimental field effects. Exact expressions for fragment information and numerical simulations with up to 24 environment qubits quantify the distinction between high mean information and reliable records across fragments and throughout a finite observation window. These results connect the geometry of local information acquisition to the fragment sizes needed for robust recording. The branch-distinguishability analysis itself requires only the conditional evolution of each environment qubit and extends to other interactions that preserve a system pointer basis.
summary:
量子达尔文主义通过冗余的环境记录来解释客观信息。早期的研究表明，不完美的记录可以被放大，环境的自我进化可以增强或抑制它们的形成。我们研究了准备、相互作用角度和场无序如何在不完美的 CNOT 模型中与随机高斯耦合和纯非相互作用环境量子位相结合。我们发现，在没有字段的情况下，单个对齐参数 $\Lambda$ 决定了条件状态可区分性的准备和交互角度依赖性。增加相互作用缺陷或局部场强可以改善或抑制记录。我们通过条件分支分离的几何结构来解释这种非单调响应。对于此处考虑的纯初始环境，$Z$ 基础对于 Holevo 信息仍然是最佳的，因此现场辅助记录不需要更改可观察的记录系统。将均匀局部场强与均方根强度相等的高斯分布场强进行比较，可以看出无序如何扩大有益和有害的场效应。

片段信息的精确表达式和多达 24 个环境量子位的数值模拟可以量化跨片段和整个有限观察窗口的高平均信息和可靠记录之间的区别。这些结果将本地信息采集的几何形状与稳健记录所需的片段大小联系起来。分支可区分性分析本身只需要每个环境量子位的条件演化，并扩展到保留系统指针基础的其他交互。
